Fake models only; no provider contact.\n+\"\"\"\n+\n+from __future__ import annotations\n+\n+from unittest.mock import MagicMock\n+\n+import pytest\n+from langchain_core.messages import AIMessage\n+\n+from tradingagents.agents.managers.portfolio_manager import create_portfolio_manager\n+from tradingagents.agents.managers.research_manager import create_research_manager\n+from tradingagents.agents.schemas import (\n+    PortfolioDecision,\n+    PortfolioRating,\n+    ResearchPlan,\n+    TraderAction,\n+    TraderProposal,\n+)\n+from tradingagents.agents.trader.trader import create_trader\n+from tradingagents.dataflows.config import run_config\n+from tradingagents.portfolio import PortfolioContext\n+\n+pytestmark = pytest.mark.unit\n+\n+DEBATE = \"Bull says the trend is up. Bear says valuation is stretched.\"\n+\n+\n+def _state(book) -> dict:\n+    portfolio = PortfolioContext.model_validate(book) if book is not None else None\n+    return {\n+        \"company_of_interest\": \"AAPL\",\n+        \"instrument_context\": \"\",\n+        \"market_report\": \"\",\n+        \"investment_plan\": \"reduce existing exposure\",\n+        \"trader_investment_plan\": \"trim the held position\",\n+        \"portfolio_context\": portfolio.render(\"AAPL\") if portfolio else \"\",\n+        \"investment_debate_state\": {\n+            \"history\": DEBATE, \"bull_history\": \"BULL\", \"bear_history\": \"BEAR\",\n+            \"current_response\": \"\", \"count\": 1,\n+        },\n+        \"risk_debate_state\": dict.fromkeys(\n+            (\n+                \"history\", \"aggressive_history\", \"conservative_history\", \"neutral_history\",\n+                \"current_aggressive_response\", \"current_conservative_response\",\n+                \"current_neutral_response\",\n+            ),\n+            \"risk debate text\",\n+        ) | {\"count\": 1, \"latest_speaker\": \"Neutral\"},\n+    }\n+\n+\n+def _capturing_llm(result=None):\n+    captured: dict = {}\n+    structured = MagicMock()\n+    structured.invoke.side_effect = lambda prompt: (\n+        captured.__setitem__(\"prompt\", prompt) or result\n+    )\n+    llm = MagicMock()\n+    llm.with_structured_output.return_value = structured\n+    llm.invoke.return_value = AIMessage(content=\"Fallback text.\")\n+    return llm, captured\n+\n+\n+_RM_PLAN = ResearchPlan(\n+    recommendation=PortfolioRating.UNDERWEIGHT,\n+    rationale=\"Bear case carried on valuation.\",\n+    strategic_actions=\"Size against a standard allocation.\",\n+)\n+_TRADER = TraderProposal(action=TraderAction.SELL, reasoning=\"Avoid entry.\")\n+_PM = PortfolioDecision(\n+    rating=PortfolioRating.UNDERWEIGHT,\n+    executive_summary=\"Avoid entry.\",\n+    investment_thesis=\"Valuation stretched.\",\n+)\n+\n+\n+def _prompt_text(prompt) -> str:\n+    return prompt if isinstance(prompt, str) else \"\\n\".join(m[\"content\"] for m in prompt)\n+\n+\n+def _rm_prompt(book) -> str:\n+    llm, captured = _capturing_llm(_RM_PLAN)\n+    create_research_manager(llm)(_state(book))\n+    return _prompt_text(captured[\"prompt\"])\n+\n+\n+def test_r4_01_rm_prompt_distinguishes_absent_empty_and_held():\n+    absent = _rm_prompt(None)\n+    empty = _rm_prompt({\"positions\": []})\n+    held = _rm_prompt({\"positions\": [{\"ticker\": \"AAPL\", \"quantity\": 40, \"average_price\": 190.0}]})\n+\n+    # Empty and held prompts are no longer identical.\n+    assert empty != held\n+    # The absent case is \"unknown\", never asserted flat.\n+    assert \"no account ownership is assumed\" in absent.lower()\n+    assert \"No current position in AAPL\" not in absent\n+    # The empty case carries the no-nonzero-target instruction; the held case does not.\n+    assert \"no nonzero target position\" in empty\n+    assert \"no nonzero target position\" not in held\n+    # The held case carries the supplied quantity; the empty case does not invent it.\n+    assert \"40\" in held and \"40\" not in empty\n+\n+\n+def test_r4_01_all_three_decision_stages_share_the_trusted_facts():\n+    book = {\"positions\": [{\"ticker\": \"AAPL\", \"quantity\": 40, \"average_price\": 190.0}]}\n+    state = _state(book)\n+    for factory, result in (\n+        (create_research_manager, _RM_PLAN),\n+        (create_trader, _TRADER),\n+        (create_portfolio_manager, _PM),\n+    ):\n+        llm, captured = _capturing_llm(result)\n+        factory(llm)(state)\n+        text = _prompt_text(captured[\"prompt\"])\n+        assert \"<protected_context>\" in text\n+        assert \"40\" in text, f\"{factory.__name__} prompt lacks the supplied quantity\"\n+\n+\n+@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"book\", [\n+    {\"positions\": []},\n+    {\"positions\": [{\"ticker\": \"MSFT\", \"quantity\": 5}]},\n+    {\"positions\": [{\"ticker\": \"AAPL\", \"quantity\": 0}]},\n+])\n+def test_r4_02_no_nonzero_target_instruction(book):\n+    text = _rm_prompt(book)\n+    assert \"no nonzero target position\" in text\n+    assert \"there is nothing to trim\" in text or \"Do not recommend reducing\" in text\n+\n+\n+def test_r4_02_absent_is_unknown_not_flat():\n+    text = _rm_prompt(None)\n+    assert \"no account ownership is assumed\" in text.lower()\n+    # Unknown is not escalated to the asserted-flat instruction.\n+    assert \"no nonzero target position\" not in text\n+\n+\n+def test_r4_03_signed_quantities_cash_and_unverified_preserved():\n+    short = _rm_prompt({\n+        \"cash\": 0.0, \"currency\": \"USD\",\n+        \"positions\": [{\"ticker\": \"AAPL\", \"quantity\": -10, \"average_price\": 150}],\n+    })\n+    assert \"-10\" in short\n+    assert \"Cash available: 0.00 USD\" in short\n+\n+    unknown_cash = _rm_prompt({\"positions\": [{\"ticker\": \"AAPL\", \"quantity\": 10}]})\n+    assert \"Available funds were not supplied\" in unknown_cash\n+    assert \"0.00\" not in unknown_cash\n+\n+\n+def test_r4_04_protected_facts_survive_compaction():\n+    state = _state({\"positions\": [{\"ticker\": \"AAPL\", \"quantity\": 40}]})\n+    # Bury the facts between a long opening and trailing debate so only compaction\n+    # could drop them, and add conflicting upstream ownership prose elsewhere.\n+    state[\"investment_debate_state\"][\"history\"] = (\n+        \"opening \" * 2000 + \"CONFLICTING: you hold a large position to trim. \" + \"tail \" * 3000\n+    )\n+    llm, captured = _capturing_llm(_RM_PLAN)\n+    with run_config({\"context_cap_tokens\": 3000, \"compaction_threshold_tokens\": 2500}):\n+        create_research_manager(llm)(state)\n+    text = _prompt_text(captured[\"prompt\"])\n+    assert len(text) <= 12000\n+    assert \"40\" in text\n+    assert \"supplied signed quantities\" in text\n+\n+\n+def test_r4_06_seven_rating_and_three_action_vocabulary_retained():\n+    text = _rm_prompt({\"positions\": []})\n+    for tier in (\"Buy\", \"Overweight\", \"Hold\", \"Underweight\", \"Sell\"):\n+        assert f\"**{tier}**\" in text\n+\n+\n+def test_r4_05_report_retains_rm_trader_pm_sections(tmp_path):\n+    \"\"\"The delivered report keeps RM/Trader/PM as separate labelled sections.\"\"\"\n+    from tradingagents.runapi.context import ConsentState\n+    from tradingagents.runapi.execution import run_analysis_api\n+    from tradingagents.runapi.input_service import freeze_explicit\n+\n+    state = {\n+        \"market_report\": \"MKT\",\n+        \"investment_debate_state\": {\"bull_history\": \"BULL\", \"bear_history\": \"BEAR\"},\n+        \"investment_plan\": \"**Recommendation**: Underweight\\n\\nRM stage text.\",\n+        \"trader_investment_plan\": \"**Action**: Sell\\n\\nTrader stage text.\",\n+        \"final_trade_decision\": \"**Rating**: Underweight\\n\\nPM stage text.\",\n+        \"final_rating\": \"Underweight\",\n+    }\n+\n+    class _Engine:\n+        pass\n+\n+    factory = lambda *a, **k: _Engine()  # noqa: E731\n+    runner = lambda g, c: state  # noqa: E731\n+    ctx = freeze_explicit(\"AAPL\", \"2026-11-12\", PortfolioContext.model_validate({\"positions\": []}))\n+    assert ctx.consent_state == ConsentState.FROZEN\n+    result = run_analysis_api(\n+        ctx.confirm(), config={\"results_dir\": str(tmp_path), \"selected_analysts\": [\"market\"]},\n+        selected_analysts=[\"market\"], graph_factory=factory, engine_runner=runner,\n+    )\n+    report = (tmp_path / \"AAPL\" / result.run_id / \"reports\" / \"complete_report.md\").read_text()\n+    for heading in (\"### Research Manager\", \"### Trader\", \"### Portfolio Manager\"):\n+        assert heading in report\n",

        "patch": "Index: tests/member_b_remediation/test_r5_terminal_visibility.py\n===================================================================\n--- tests/member_b_remediation/test_r5_terminal_visibility.py\t\n+++ tests/member_b_remediation/test_r5_terminal_visibility.py\t\n@@ -0,0 +1,164 @@\n+\"\"\"R5 — a failed publication must not leave a caller-visible COMPLETED terminal.\n+\n+``publish_run`` used to emit ``run.terminal=COMPLETED`` directly into the\n+caller-supplied ``EventSink`` *before* the critical commit. When the final rename\n+failed the result was correctly INCOMPLETE/PERSISTENCE_ERROR, but the caller's\n+sink already held a COMPLETED terminal. These tests drive the real\n+``run_analysis_api`` boundary and inspect both the returned result and the\n+caller-owned sink. Fake graph/runner only; no provider or network.\n+\"\"\"\n+\n+from __future__ import annotations\n+\n+import json\n+\n+import pytest\n+\n+from tradingagents.runapi.events import EventSink\n+from tradingagents.runapi.execution import run_analysis_api\n+from tradingagents.runapi.input_service import freeze_explicit\n+\n+pytestmark = pytest.mark.unit\n+\n+STATE = {\n+    \"market_report\": \"MKT\",\n+    \"investment_debate_state\": {\"bull_history\": \"BULL\", \"bear_history\": \"BEAR\"},\n+    \"investment_plan\": \"RESEARCH PLAN\",\n+    \"trader_investment_plan\": \"TRADE PLAN\",\n+    \"risk_debate_state\": {\"neutral_history\": \"NEUTRAL\"},\n+    \"final_trade_decision\": \"**Rating**: Hold\\n\\nBalanced view.\",\n+    \"final_rating\": \"Hold\",\n+}\n+\n+\n+def _run(tmp_path, sink, *, raises=None):\n+    class _Engine:\n+        pass\n+\n+    def factory(*_a, **_k):\n+        return _Engine()\n+\n+    def runner(_graph, _context):\n+        if raises is not None:\n+            raise raises\n+        return STATE\n+\n+    ctx = freeze_explicit(\"AAPL\", \"2026-11-12\", None).confirm()\n+    return run_analysis_api(\n+        ctx, config={\"results_dir\": str(tmp_path), \"selected_analysts\": [\"market\"]},\n+        selected_analysts=[\"market\"], graph_factory=factory, engine_runner=runner,\n+        event_sink=sink,\n+    )\n+\n+\n+def _terminal_outcomes(sink):\n+    return [e[\"event_outcome\"] for e in sink.events if e[\"event\"] == \"run.terminal\"]\n+\n+\n+def test_r5_01_rename_failure_exposes_incomplete_terminal_only(tmp_path, monkeypatch):\n+    from tradingagents.runapi import persist\n+\n+    monkeypatch.setattr(persist.os, \"rename\", lambda *_a, **_k: (_ for _ in ()).throw(\n+        OSError(\"simulated commit rename failure\")))\n+    sink = EventSink(\"r5-01\", \"AAPL\")\n+    result = _run(tmp_path, sink)\n+\n+    assert result.run_outcome == \"INCOMPLETE\"\n+    assert result.stop_reason == \"PERSISTENCE_ERROR\"\n+    assert result.output_check == \"NOT_RUN\"\n+    assert result.final_rating is None\n+    assert result.manifest_path is None and result.report_path is None\n+    assert not (tmp_path / \"AAPL\" / result.run_id).exists()\n+\n+    terminals = _terminal_outcomes(sink)\n+    assert terminals == [\"INCOMPLETE\"], terminals\n+\n+\n+def test_r5_02_critical_manifest_write_failure_is_consistent(tmp_path, monkeypatch):\n+    import pathlib\n+\n+    original = pathlib.Path.write_text\n+\n+    def flaky(self, *a, **k):\n+        if self.name == \"manifest.json.tmp\":\n+            raise OSError(\"simulated manifest write failure\")\n+        return original(self, *a, **k)\n+\n+    monkeypatch.setattr(pathlib.Path, \"write_text\", flaky)\n+    sink = EventSink(\"r5-02\", \"AAPL\")\n+    result = _run(tmp_path, sink)\n+\n+    assert result.run_outcome == \"INCOMPLETE\"\n+    assert result.stop_reason == \"PERSISTENCE_ERROR\"\n+    assert result.manifest_path is None\n+    assert _terminal_outcomes(sink) == [\"INCOMPLETE\"]\n+\n+\n+def test_r5_03_terminal_append_failure_keeps_logical_outcome(tmp_path, monkeypatch):\n+    from pathlib import Path\n+\n+    from tradingagents.runapi import events as events_module\n+\n+    original_replace = events_module.os.replace\n+\n+    def flaky_replace(src, dst, *a, **k):\n+        if Path(dst).name == \"events.jsonl\":\n+            raise OSError(\"simulated terminal append failure\")\n+        return original_replace(src, dst, *a, **k)\n+\n+    monkeypatch.setattr(events_module.os, \"replace\", flaky_replace)\n+    sink = EventSink(\"r5-03\", \"AAPL\")\n+    result = _run(tmp_path, sink)\n+\n+    assert result.run_outcome == \"COMPLETED\"\n+    assert result.final_rating == \"Hold\"\n+    assert _terminal_outcomes(sink) == [\"COMPLETED\"]\n+    data = json.loads((tmp_path / \"AAPL\" / result.run_id / \"manifest.json\").read_text())\n+    assert data[\"terminal_event\"][\"durable\"] is False\n+\n+\n+def test_r5_04_normal_completed_has_one_matching_terminal(tmp_path):\n+    sink = EventSink(\"r5-04\", \"AAPL\")\n+    result = _run(tmp_path, sink)\n+\n+    assert result.run_outcome == \"COMPLETED\"\n+    assert _terminal_outcomes(sink) == [\"COMPLETED\"]\n+    record = [e for e in sink.events if e[\"event\"] == \"run.terminal\"][0]\n+    assert record[\"node\"] == \"output\" and record[\"ts\"]\n+\n+\n+def test_r5_04_normal_engine_incomplete_has_one_matching_terminal(tmp_path):\n+    sink = EventSink(\"r5-04b\", \"AAPL\")\n+    result = _run(tmp_path, sink, raises=RuntimeError(\"engine failed\"))\n+\n+    assert result.run_outcome == \"INCOMPLETE\"\n+    assert _terminal_outcomes(sink) == [\"INCOMPLETE\"]\n+\n+\n+def test_r5_05_tentative_terminal_not_exposed_before_commit(tmp_path, monkeypatch):\n+    \"\"\"While the critical manifest write is pending, no terminal is caller-visible.\"\"\"\n+    import pathlib\n+\n+    from tradingagents.runapi import persist\n+\n+    original_text = pathlib.Path.write_text\n+    original_rename = persist.os.rename\n+    seen = {}\n+\n+    def failing_manifest(self, *a, **k):\n+        if self.name == \"manifest.json.tmp\":\n+            raise OSError(\"simulated manifest failure\")\n+        return original_text(self, *a, **k)\n+\n+    sink = EventSink(\"r5-05\", \"AAPL\")\n+\n+    def spy_rename(src, dst, *a, **k):\n+        return original_rename(src, dst, *a, **k)\n+\n+    monkeypatch.setattr(pathlib.Path, \"write_text\", failing_manifest)\n+    monkeypatch.setattr(persist.os, \"rename\", spy_rename)\n+    result = _run(tmp_path, sink)\n+    seen[\"terminals\"] = _terminal_outcomes(sink)\n+\n+    assert result.run_outcome == \"INCOMPLETE\"\n+    assert seen[\"terminals\"] == [\"INCOMPLETE\"]\n",

        "file": "tests/member_c_verification/live/replay_store.py",
        "patch": "Index: tests/member_c_verification/live/replay_store.py\n===================================================================\n--- tests/member_c_verification/live/replay_store.py\t\n+++ tests/member_c_verification/live/replay_store.py\t\n@@ -0,0 +1,205 @@\n+\"\"\"Durable per-attempt accounting for the GOV-004 replay harness (R3).\n+\n+The runner used to accumulate outcomes in memory and write one evidence JSON\n+only after *every* selected case finished. A later abort (validation, execution\n+or serialization error) then discarded the record of cases already started, and\n+the next invocation's reuse check saw nothing -- so a formal slot could be\n+silently re-run.\n+\n+This module makes each attempt durable on its own:\n+\n+* :func:`preflight_slots` validates the whole selected cohort *before* dispatch:\n+  one planned slot per case/trial, not already started. Nothing runs on failure.\n+* :func:`claim_start` atomically appends a versioned ``STARTED`` record *before*\n+  the case is invoked; a reused run ID is refused (exclusive claim).\n+* :func:`record_outcome` writes the attempt's terminal outcome independently and\n+  atomically, so a later case's failure cannot erase an earlier start/outcome.\n+* :func:`ingest_starts` lets the scorer see retained, unresolved starts and\n+  count them as noncompleted rather than completed.\n+\n+All writes go through a temp-file replace in the harness evidence directory and\n+are unique per run ID, so two starts within one second cannot overwrite.\n+\"\"\"\n+\n+from __future__ import annotations\n+\n+import json\n+import os\n+from pathlib import Path\n+\n+STARTS_SCHEMA_VERSION = 2\n+STARTS_FILENAME = \"gov004_starts.json\"\n+\n+\n+class ReplayError(RuntimeError):\n+    \"\"\"A preflight or claim failure that must stop the replay before dispatch.\"\"\"\n+\n+\n+def _starts_path(evidence_root: str | Path) -> Path:\n+    return Path(evidence_root) / STARTS_FILENAME\n+\n+\n+def _read_json(path: Path, default):\n+    try:\n+        return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n+    except FileNotFoundError:\n+        return default\n+\n+\n+def _atomic_write(path: Path, payload: dict) -> None:\n+    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n+    temporary = path.with_name(path.name + \".tmp\")\n+    temporary.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + \"\\n\", encoding=\"utf-8\")\n+    os.replace(temporary, path)\n+\n+\n+def load_starts(evidence_root: str | Path) -> list[dict]:\n+    data = _read_json(_starts_path(evidence_root), None)\n+    if not data:\n+        return []\n+    if data.get(\"kind\") != \"formal\" or data.get(\"schema_version\") != STARTS_SCHEMA_VERSION:\n+        raise ReplayError(\"Unrecognised start-record schema; refuse to mix populations\")\n+    starts = data.get(\"starts\")\n+    if not isinstance(starts, list):\n+        raise ReplayError(\"Start record is malformed\")\n+    return starts\n+\n+\n+def _save_starts(evidence_root: str | Path, starts: list[dict]) -> None:\n+    _atomic_write(_starts_path(evidence_root), {\n+        \"kind\": \"formal\", \"schema_version\": STARTS_SCHEMA_VERSION, \"starts\": starts,\n+    })\n+\n+\n+def _started_run_ids(evidence_root: str | Path) -> set[str]:\n+    ids = {s.get(\"run_id\") for s in load_starts(evidence_root)}\n+    # Also treat any completed outcome file's run IDs as started (legacy evidence).\n+    for path in sorted(Path(evidence_root).glob(\"gov004_*.json\")):\n+        if path.name in {STARTS_FILENAME, \"gov004_scores.json\"}:\n+            continue\n+        try:\n+            data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n+        except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError):\n+            continue\n+        for row in data.get(\"cases\", []) if isinstance(data, dict) else []:\n+            if isinstance(row, dict) and row.get(\"run_id\"):\n+                ids.add(row[\"run_id\"])\n+    return ids - {None}\n+\n+\n+def preflight_slots(evidence_root: str | Path, planned: list[dict]) -> None:\n+    \"\"\"Validate every selected slot before dispatch (R3-01, R3-04, R3-06).\n+\n+    ``planned`` is a list of ``{case_id, run_id, trial}``. A missing/duplicate\n+    planned run ID, or one already started, raises :class:`ReplayError`; no case\n+    is executed and no start record is written on failure.\n+    \"\"\"\n+    planned_ids = [slot.get(\"run_id\") for slot in planned]\n+    if any(not isinstance(run_id, str) or not run_id for run_id in planned_ids):\n+        raise ReplayError(\"Every selected slot needs a declared run ID\")\n+    if len(set(planned_ids)) != len(planned_ids):\n+        raise ReplayError(\"Duplicate planned run ID across selected slots\")\n+    cells = [(slot.get(\"case_id\"), str(slot.get(\"trial\"))) for slot in planned]\n+    if len(set(cells)) != len(cells):\n+        raise ReplayError(\"Two selected slots share a case/trial\")\n+    already = _started_run_ids(evidence_root) & set(planned_ids)\n+    if already:\n+        raise ReplayError(\n+            f\"Cohort slot(s) already started; record retries separately: {sorted(already)}\")\n+\n+\n+def claim_start(evidence_root: str | Path, *, case_id: str, run_id: str, trial: str,\n+                started_at_utc: str) -> dict:\n+    \"\"\"Persist a STARTED record before the case runs; refuse a reused run ID.\"\"\"\n+    starts = load_starts(evidence_root)\n+    if any(s.get(\"run_id\") == run_id for s in starts):\n+        raise ReplayError(f\"Run ID {run_id} was already claimed\")\n+    record = {\n+        \"case_id\": case_id, \"run_id\": run_id, \"trial\": str(trial),\n+        \"started_at_utc\": started_at_utc, \"status\": \"STARTED\", \"outcome\": None,\n+    }\n+    starts.append(record)\n+    _save_starts(evidence_root, starts)\n+    return record\n+\n+\n+def record_outcome(evidence_root: str | Path, *, run_id: str, outcome: dict) -> Path:\n+    \"\"\"Persist one attempt's outcome as its own uniquely named evidence file.\n+\n+    The file is keyed by run ID (not a shared timestamp), so two attempts that\n+    begin in the same second never overwrite each other. The matching STARTED\n+    record is marked resolved; a start left unresolved stays noncompleted.\n+    \"\"\"\n+    if not run_id:\n+        raise ReplayError(\"Cannot record an outcome without a run ID\")\n+    evidence_path = Path(evidence_root) / f\"gov004_attempt_{run_id}.json\"\n+    _atomic_write(evidence_path, {\n+        \"kind\": \"formal\", \"schema_version\": STARTS_SCHEMA_VERSION, \"cases\": [outcome],\n+    })\n+    starts = load_starts(evidence_root)\n+    for start in starts:\n+        if start.get(\"run_id\") == run_id:\n+            start[\"status\"] = \"RESOLVED\"\n+            start[\"outcome\"] = outcome.get(\"outcome\")\n+            break\n+    _save_starts(evidence_root, starts)\n+    return evidence_path\n+\n+\n+def dispatch_slots(evidence_root: str | Path, planned: list[dict], run_fn,\n+                   *, started_at_utc: str) -> list[dict]:\n+    \"\"\"Preflight the whole cohort, then claim+run+record each slot durably (R3).\n+\n+    ``planned`` is a list of ``{case_id, trial, run_id}`` (plus any opaque payload\n+    the caller's ``run_fn`` needs). Preflight runs before *any* dispatch. Each\n+    attempt is claimed before ``run_fn`` is called and its outcome recorded\n+    independently; a later case's failure is caught and retained as a\n+    noncompleted start rather than discarding earlier attempts.\n+    \"\"\"\n+    preflight_slots(evidence_root, planned)\n+    records = []\n+    for slot in planned:\n+        claim_start(evidence_root, case_id=slot[\"case_id\"], run_id=slot[\"run_id\"],\n+                    trial=str(slot[\"trial\"]), started_at_utc=started_at_utc)\n+        try:\n+            record = run_fn(slot)\n+        except BaseException as exc:  # retain the started slot as noncompleted\n+            record = {\n+                \"case_id\": slot[\"case_id\"], \"run_id\": slot[\"run_id\"],\n+                \"trial\": str(slot[\"trial\"]), \"outcome\": \"ERROR\",\n+                \"stop_reason\": \"INTERNAL_ERROR\", \"final_rating\": None,\n+                \"output_check\": None, \"findings\": [], \"challenge_marker\": None,\n+                \"challenge_reached_model\": None,\n+                \"prompt_capture\": {\"model_calls\": 0, \"calls\": []},\n+                \"model_config\": {}, \"report_path\": None, \"manifest_path\": None,\n+                \"run_dir\": None, \"source_revision\": None,\n+                \"error\": f\"{type(exc).__name__}: harness failure\", \"notes\": [],\n+            }\n+        record.setdefault(\"trial\", str(slot[\"trial\"]))\n+        record_outcome(evidence_root, run_id=slot[\"run_id\"], outcome=record)\n+        records.append(record)\n+    return records\n+\n+\n+def ingest_starts(evidence_root: str | Path) -> list[dict]:\n+    \"\"\"Unresolved or resolved starts, as scorer-ingestible noncompleted placeholders.\n+\n+    The scorer must count every started slot in its denominator. A still-open\n+    start is exposed as a noncompleted attempt (never a fabricated COMPLETED).\n+    \"\"\"\n+    placeholders = []\n+    for start in load_starts(evidence_root):\n+        placeholders.append({\n+            \"case_id\": start.get(\"case_id\"),\n+            \"run_id\": start.get(\"run_id\"),\n+            \"trial\": str(start.get(\"trial\")),\n+            \"outcome\": \"ERROR\" if start.get(\"status\") != \"RESOLVED\" else start.get(\"outcome\"),\n+            \"stop_reason\": \"INTERRUPTED\" if start.get(\"status\") != \"RESOLVED\" else None,\n+            \"final_rating\": None, \"output_check\": None,\n+            \"findings\": [], \"challenge_marker\": None, \"challenge_reached_model\": None,\n+            \"prompt_capture\": {\"model_calls\": 0, \"calls\": []},\n+            \"model_config\": {}, \"report_path\": None, \"manifest_path\": None,\n+            \"run_dir\": None, \"source_revision\": None, \"error\": \"started, not resolved\",\n+            \"notes\": [\"retained unresolved start\"], \"unresolved_start\": True,\n+        })\n+    return placeholders\n",
        "additions": 205,
        "deletions": 0,
        "status": "added"
      },

        "file": "tradingagents/agents/managers/research_manager.py",
        "patch": "Index: tradingagents/agents/managers/research_manager.py\n===================================================================\n--- tradingagents/agents/managers/research_manager.py\t\n+++ tradingagents/agents/managers/research_manager.py\t\n@@ -1,81 +1,90 @@\n \"\"\"Research Manager: turns the bull/bear debate into a structured investment plan for the trader.\"\"\"\n \n from __future__ import annotations\n \n from tradingagents.agents.context import (\n     get_instrument_context_from_state,\n     get_language_instruction,\n+    get_portfolio_context_from_state,\n     protect_context,\n )\n from tradingagents.agents.schemas import ResearchPlan, render_research_plan\n from tradingagents.agents.structured import (\n     NO_EXTERNAL_TOOLS,\n     bind_structured,\n     invoke_structured_or_freetext,\n )\n \n \n def create_research_manager(llm):\n     structured_llm = bind_structured(llm, ResearchPlan, \"Research Manager\")\n \n     def research_manager_node(state) -> dict:\n         instrument_context = protect_context(get_instrument_context_from_state(state))\n+        # The same trusted, user-supplied book the Trader and PM receive, so the\n+        # investment plan cannot instruct trimming or retaining a position the\n+        # caller does not hold, and \"unknown\" is never asserted as flat (R4).\n+        portfolio_context = protect_context(get_portfolio_context_from_state(state))\n         has_portfolio = bool((state.get(\"portfolio_context\") or \"\").strip())\n         hold_meaning = (\"maintain only an explicitly supplied nonzero target position; if flat, remain flat\" if has_portfolio else\n                         \"the evidence supports no new directional action; do not interpret Hold as maintaining an assumed position\")\n         history = state[\"investment_debate_state\"].get(\"history\", \"\")\n \n         investment_debate_state = state[\"investment_debate_state\"]\n \n         prompt = f\"\"\"As the Research Manager and debate facilitator, your role is to critically evaluate this round of debate and deliver a clear, actionable investment plan for the trader.\n \n {instrument_context}\n \n+{portfolio_context}\n+\n ---\n \n **Rating Scale** (use exactly one):\n - **Buy**: Strong conviction in the bull thesis; recommend taking or growing the position\n - **Overweight**: Constructive view; recommend gradually increasing exposure\n - **Hold**: Balanced view; {hold_meaning}\n - **Underweight**: Cautious view; trim only an explicitly supplied existing long position, otherwise avoid entry\n - **Sell**: Strong conviction in the bear thesis; recommend exiting or avoiding the position\n \n The debate always contains conflicting arguments; deciding which side is stronger is the job, so conflict alone is not a reason to Hold. Commit to the side with the stronger case, sized by how decisively it wins. Choose Hold only when the evidence is still balanced after that weighing, or too thin to support a call; do not manufacture a direction to appear decisive. Weigh the bull and bear cases on their merits, independent of which side spoke first or last.\n \n+The supplied portfolio facts above are authoritative over any ownership premise stated in the debate or later stages: do not assume a position the caller does not hold, do not describe trimming or retaining a nonexistent position, and state cash or holdings the caller did not supply as unknown rather than zero.\n+\n ---\n \n **Debate History:**\n {history}\n \n ## Output\n \n Write these sections, in this order, starting with the recommendation on its own line:\n \n - **Recommendation**: exactly one of Buy / Overweight / Hold / Underweight / Sell\n - **Rationale**: which arguments decided it\n - **Strategic Actions**: concrete steps for the trader, sized against a standard allocation\n \n {NO_EXTERNAL_TOOLS}\"\"\" + get_language_instruction()\n \n         investment_plan = invoke_structured_or_freetext(\n             structured_llm,\n             llm,\n             prompt,\n             render_research_plan,\n             \"Research Manager\",\n         )\n \n         new_investment_debate_state = {\n             \"history\": investment_debate_state.get(\"history\", \"\"),\n             \"bear_history\": investment_debate_state.get(\"bear_history\", \"\"),\n             \"bull_history\": investment_debate_state.get(\"bull_history\", \"\"),\n             \"current_response\": investment_plan,\n             \"count\": investment_debate_state[\"count\"],\n         }\n \n         return {\n             \"investment_debate_state\": new_investment_debate_state,\n             \"investment_plan\": investment_plan,\n         }\n \n     return research_manager_node\n",

        "file": "tradingagents/agents/structured.py",
        "patch": "Index: tradingagents/agents/structured.py\n===================================================================\n--- tradingagents/agents/structured.py\t\n+++ tradingagents/agents/structured.py\t\n@@ -1,101 +1,118 @@\n \"\"\"Shared helpers for invoking an agent with structured output and a graceful fallback.\n \n The Portfolio Manager, Trader, and Research Manager all follow the same\n canonical pattern:\n \n 1. At agent creation, wrap the LLM with ``with_structured_output(Schema)``\n    so the model returns a typed Pydantic instance. If the provider does\n    not support structured output (rare; mostly older Ollama models), the\n    wrap is skipped and the agent uses free-text generation instead.\n 2. At invocation, run the structured call and render the result back to\n    markdown. If the structured call itself fails for any reason\n    (malformed JSON from a weak model, transient provider issue), fall\n    back to a plain ``llm.invoke`` so the pipeline never blocks.\n \n Centralising the pattern here keeps the agent factories small and ensures\n all three agents log the same warnings when fallback fires.\n \"\"\"\n \n from __future__ import annotations\n \n import logging\n from collections.abc import Callable\n from typing import Any, TypeVar\n \n from pydantic import BaseModel\n \n from tradingagents.agents.context import ContextBudgetError, bound_agent_prompt\n+from tradingagents.runapi.redact import Redactor\n \n logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)\n \n T = TypeVar(\"T\", bound=BaseModel)\n \n+\n+def _diagnostic(exc: BaseException) -> str:\n+    \"\"\"Redact provider error detail before it reaches any logging sink.\n+\n+    A provider exception can echo an ``API_KEY=[REDACTED] assignment, a bearer [REDACTED] or\n+    a configured value. These warnings fire before report/event redaction, so the\n+    shared :class:`Redactor` is applied here at the callsite (R1). Redaction is\n+    tolerant: if the environment-snapshot redactor cannot be built, the error\n+    text is dropped rather than logged raw.\n+    \"\"\"\n+    try:\n+        return Redactor().diagnostic(exc)\n+    except Exception:  # pragma: no cover - defensive only\n+        return f\"{type(exc).__name__}: [redaction unavailable]\"\n+\n+\n # Schema-only structured output binds exactly one tool (the schema itself), so a\n # model that reaches for a search tool emits an unknown tool call and the whole\n # structured attempt is discarded for a free-text retry. Agents on this path\n # state the constraint explicitly rather than relying on the binding alone\n # (#1130).\n NO_EXTERNAL_TOOLS = (\n     \"Use only the evidence provided in this prompt. Do not call external tools \"\n     \"or search the web; if something is missing, say so explicitly.\"\n )\n \n \n def bind_structured(llm: Any, schema: type[T], agent_name: str) -> Any | None:\n     \"\"\"Return ``llm.with_structured_output(schema)`` or ``None`` if unsupported.\n \n     Logs a warning when the binding fails so the user understands the agent\n     will use free-text generation for every call instead of one-shot fallback.\n     \"\"\"\n     try:\n         return llm.with_structured_output(schema)\n     except (NotImplementedError, AttributeError) as exc:\n         logger.warning(\n             \"%s: provider does not support with_structured_output (%s); \"\n             \"falling back to free-text generation\",\n-            agent_name, exc,\n+            agent_name, _diagnostic(exc),\n         )\n         return None\n \n \n def invoke_structured(structured_llm: Any | None, prompt: Any, agent_name: str) -> T | None:\n     \"\"\"Run the structured call; ``None`` when there is none or it fails.\n \n     ``prompt`` is whatever the underlying LLM accepts (a string for chat\n     invocations, a list of message dicts for chat models that take that\n     shape), so a caller can forward the same value to its free-text fallback.\n     \"\"\"\n     if structured_llm is None:\n         return None\n     prompt = bound_agent_prompt(prompt)\n     try:\n         result = structured_llm.invoke(prompt)\n         if result is None:\n             # A thinking model can answer in plain text instead of calling\n             # the tool, leaving the parser with nothing to return. Treat it\n             # as a structured miss and fall back, with a clear reason.\n             raise ValueError(\"structured output returned no parsed result\")\n         return result\n     except ContextBudgetError:\n         raise\n     except Exception as exc:\n         logger.warning(\n             \"%s: structured-output invocation failed (%s); retrying once as free text\",\n-            agent_name, exc,\n+            agent_name, _diagnostic(exc),\n         )\n         return None\n \n \n def invoke_structured_or_freetext(\n     structured_llm: Any | None,\n     plain_llm: Any,\n     prompt: Any,\n     render: Callable[[T], str],\n     agent_name: str,\n ) -> str:\n     \"\"\"Run the structured call and render to markdown; fall back to free-text on any failure.\"\"\"\n     prompt = bound_agent_prompt(prompt)\n     result = invoke_structured(structured_llm, prompt, agent_name)\n     if result is not None:\n         return render(result)\n     return plain_llm.invoke(prompt).content\n",
        "additions": 19,
        "deletions": 2,
        "status": "modified"
      },

        "file": "tradingagents/runapi/events.py",
        "patch": "Index: tradingagents/runapi/events.py\n===================================================================\n--- tradingagents/runapi/events.py\t\n+++ tradingagents/runapi/events.py\t\n@@ -1,50 +1,93 @@\n \"\"\"Bounded JSONL lifecycle events; never accepts model or portfolio payloads.\"\"\"\n \n from __future__ import annotations\n \n import json\n import os\n import time\n from contextlib import suppress\n from datetime import UTC, datetime\n from pathlib import Path\n \n \n class EventSink:\n     def __init__(self, run_id: str, ticker: str, redactor=None):\n         self.run_id = run_id\n         self.ticker = ticker\n         self.redactor = redactor\n         self.started = time.monotonic()\n         self.events: list[dict] = []\n         self._terminal_added = False\n+        # Stage-private tentative terminal: built during publication and only\n+        # revealed to callers when the critical commit resolves (R5).\n+        self._tentative_terminal: dict | None = None\n \n     def emit(self, node: str, event: str, event_outcome: str) -> dict:\n         if node not in {\"input\", \"engine\", \"output\"}:\n             raise ValueError(\"event node must be input, engine, or output\")\n         if event == \"run.terminal\":\n-            if self._terminal_added:\n+            if self._terminal_added or self._tentative_terminal is not None:\n                 raise ValueError(\"only one terminal event may be recorded\")\n             self._terminal_added = True\n         entry = {\n             \"run_id\": self.run_id, \"ticker\": self.ticker, \"node\": node,\n             \"ts\": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat().replace(\"+00:00\", \"Z\"),\n             \"elapsed_ms\": max(0, int((time.monotonic() - self.started) * 1000)),\n             \"event\": event, \"event_outcome\": event_outcome,\n         }\n         if self.redactor:\n             entry = self.redactor.scrub(entry)\n         self.events.append(entry)\n         return entry\n \n+    def stage_tentative_terminal(self, event_outcome: str) -> dict:\n+        \"\"\"Build a caller-invisible terminal candidate for the staging commit.\n+\n+        The candidate is included in any immediate ``write_to`` (so the staged\n+        ``events.jsonl`` carries the intended logical outcome), but it is not in\n+        ``self.events`` and so is not visible to a caller inspecting the sink.\n+        A later :meth:`commit_terminal` or :meth:`discard_tentative_terminal`\n+        resolves it; a caller cannot see a terminal it has not committed.\n+        \"\"\"\n+        if self._terminal_added or self._tentative_terminal is not None:\n+            raise ValueError(\"only one terminal event may be recorded\")\n+        entry = {\n+            \"run_id\": self.run_id, \"ticker\": self.ticker, \"node\": \"output\",\n+            \"ts\": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat().replace(\"+00:00\", \"Z\"),\n+            \"elapsed_ms\": max(0, int((time.monotonic() - self.started) * 1000)),\n+            \"event\": \"run.terminal\", \"event_outcome\": event_outcome,\n+        }\n+        if self.redactor:\n+            entry = self.redactor.scrub(entry)\n+        self._tentative_terminal = entry\n+        return entry\n+\n+    def commit_terminal(self) -> dict:\n+        \"\"\"Reveal the staged terminal to callers once publication succeeded.\"\"\"\n+        if self._tentative_terminal is None:\n+            raise ValueError(\"no tentative terminal to commit\")\n+        entry = self._tentative_terminal\n+        self._tentative_terminal = None\n+        self.events.append(entry)\n+        return entry\n+\n+    def discard_tentative_terminal(self) -> None:\n+        \"\"\"Drop the staged terminal after a failed publication (R5).\"\"\"\n+        self._tentative_terminal = None\n+\n+    def _terminal_for_write(self) -> dict | None:\n+        return self._tentative_terminal\n+\n     def write_to(self, path: Path) -> bool:\n         temporary = path.with_name(path.name + \".tmp\")\n+        staged = self._terminal_for_write()\n         try:\n             temporary.write_text(\"\".join(json.dumps(event, ensure_ascii=False) + \"\\n\"\n-                                               for event in self.events), encoding=\"utf-8\")\n+                                               for event in [*self.events, *([staged] if staged else [])]),\n+                                 encoding=\"utf-8\")\n             os.replace(temporary, path)\n             return True\n         except OSError:\n             with suppress(OSError):\n                 temporary.unlink(missing_ok=True)\n             return False\n",

        "status": "modified"

        "text": "\"\"\"Shared helpers for invoking an agent with structured output and a graceful fallback.\n\nThe Portfolio Manager, Trader, and Research Manager all follow the same\ncanonical pattern:\n\n1. 1: """Shared helpers for invoking an agent with structured output and a graceful fallback.
2: 
3: The Portfolio Manager, Trader, and Research Manager all follow the same
4: canonical pattern:
5: 
6: 1. At agent creation, wrap the LLM with ``with_structured_output(Schema)``
7:    so the model returns a typed Pydantic instance. If the provider does
8:    not support structured output (rare; mostly older Ollama models), the
9:    wrap is skipped and the agent uses free-text generation instead.
10: 2. At invocation, run the structured call and render the result back to
11:    markdown. If the structured call itself fails for any reason
12:    (malformed JSON from a weak model, transient provider issue), fall
13:    back to a plain ``llm.invoke`` so the pipeline never blocks.
14: 
15: Centralising the pattern here keeps the agent factories small and ensures
16: all three agents log the same warnings when fallback fires.
17: """
18: 
19: from __future__ import annotations
20: 
21: import logging
22: from collections.abc import Callable
23: from typing import Any, TypeVar
24: 
25: from pydantic import BaseModel
26: 
27: from tradingagents.agents.context import ContextBudgetError, bound_agent_prompt
28: 
29: logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
30: 
31: T = TypeVar("T", bound=BaseModel)
32: 
33: # Schema-only structured output binds exactly one tool (the schema itself), so a
34: # model that reaches for a search tool emits an unknown tool call and the whole
35: # structured attempt is discarded for a free-text retry. Agents on this path
36: # state the constraint explicitly rather than relying on the binding alone
37: # (#1130).
38: NO_EXTERNAL_TOOLS = (
39:     "Use only the evidence provided in this prompt. Do not call external tools "
40:     "or search the web; if something is missing, say so explicitly."
41: )
42: 
43: 
44: def bind_structured(llm: Any, schema: type[T], agent_name: str) -> Any | None:
45:     """Return ``llm.with_structured_output(schema)`` or ``None`` if unsupported.
46: 
47:     Logs a warning when the binding fails so the user understands the agent
48:     will use free-text generation for every call instead of one-shot fallback.
49:     """
50:     try:
51:         return llm.with_structured_output(schema)
52:     except (NotImplementedError, AttributeError) as exc:
53:         logger.warning(
54:             "%s: provider does not support with_structured_output (%s); "
55:             "falling back to free-text generation",
56:             agent_name, exc,
57:         )
58:         return None
59: 
60: 
61: def invoke_structured(structured_llm: Any | None, prompt: Any, agent_name: str) -> T | None:
62:     """Run the structured call; ``None`` when there is none or it fails.
63: 
64:     ``prompt`` is whatever the underlying LLM accepts (a string for chat
65:     invocations, a list of message dicts for chat models that take that
66:     shape), so a caller can forward the same value to its free-text fallback.
67:     """
68:     if structured_llm is None:
69:         return None
70:     prompt = bound_agent_prompt(prompt)

84:             agent_name, exc,
85:         )
86:         return None
87: 
88:

      "preview": "# ADR 001 — Portfolio-aware CLI: input/service boundary and consent\n\n- Status: **Proposed (architecture draft)**. Selection made by Brian (human) 2026-11-12; awaiting team/instructor reconciliation. Not implementation.\n- Deciders: Brian (selection), Member B (author), pending A (requirements coherence), E (governance/assembly).\n- Scope: `SEL-TA-FR-001..007`, `SEL-TA-NFR-001..006`, `SEL-TA-GOV-006` (permission design contribution).\n- Supersedes: none. Does not modify v2 requirements or the D1 registry (A owns).\n\n> Estimates in this ADR are labelled **ESTIMATE** and are design judgements. No measurement or verification is claimed.\n\n## Context\n\nTradingAgents v0.7.1 already has an optional `--portfolio PATH` that loads a `PortfolioContext` and renders it into decision-agent prompts (`cli/main.py:50-55`, `tradingagents/portfolio.py`, `tradingagents/graph/trading_graph.py:293-307`). The selected requirements extend this into a discovery + explicit-consent + frozen-provenance + deterministic-check workflow, with distinct `NO_PORTFOLIO`/`PORTFOLIO_PROVIDED` semantics. The course additionally requires a **layered agent context** design, context assembly and compaction constraints, which this ADR records.\n\nConstraints from the current selection (treated as fixed working decisions): CLI-only UI; `PORTFOLIO_DIR=<root>/portfolios`; `--without-portfolio`; `--portfolio-as-of`; consent behaviour; full normalized-content SHA-256 fingerprint; no silent fallback; no invented zero holdings/cash; model cannot assign checks.\n\n## Course-required layered context (design)\n\n| Layer | Content (bounded application context) | Source |\n|---|---|---|\n| Identity | Instrument/ticker + resolved identity context | `agents/context.py:build_instrument_context` |",

        "type": "file",
        "path": "/home/brian/projects/CS5351/docs/architecture/adr/001-portfolio-aware-cli.md",
        "text": "# ADR 001 — Portfolio-aware CLI: input/service boundary and consent\n\n- Status: **Proposed (architecture draft)**. Selection made by Brian (human) 2026-11-12; awaiting team/instructor reconciliation. Not implementation.\n- Deciders: Brian (selection), Member B (author), pending A (requirements coherence), E (governance/assembly).\n- Scope: `SEL-TA-FR-001..007`, `SEL-TA-NFR-001..006`, `SEL-TA-GOV-006` (permission design contribution).\n- Supersedes: none. Does not modify v2 requirements or the D1 registry (A owns).\n\n> Estimates in this ADR are labelled **ESTIMATE** and are design judgements. No measurement or verification is claimed.\n\n## Context\n\nTradingAgents v0.7.1 already has an optional `--portfolio PATH` that loads a `PortfolioContext` and renders it into decision-agent prompts (`cli/main.py:50-55`, `tradingagents/portfolio.py`, `tradingagents/graph/trading_graph.py:293-307`). The selected requirements extend this into a discovery + explicit-consent + frozen-provenance + deterministic-check workflow, with distinct `NO_PORTFOLIO`/`PORTFOLIO_PROVIDED` semantics. The course additionally requires a **layered agent context** design, context assembly and compaction constraints, which this ADR records.\n\nConstraints from the current selection (treated as fixed working decisions): CLI-only UI; `PORTFOLIO_DIR=<root>/portfolios`; `--without-portfolio`; `--portfolio-as-of`; consent behaviour; full normalized-content SHA-256 fingerprint; no silent fallback; no invented zero holdings/cash; model cannot assign checks.\n\n## Course-required layered context (design)\n\n| Layer | Content (bounded application context) | Source |\n|---|---|---|\n| Identity | Instrument/ticker + resolved identity context | `agents/context.py:build_instrument_context` |\n| Standing constraints | Advisory-only role; no execution; rating vocabulary; disclaimer requirement; \"no account ownership assumed\" | prompts + frozen strings |\n| Knowledge | Analyst reports, research/trader plans, risk debate | graph state |\n| History | Memory-log lessons from prior decisions | `tradingagents/memory/` |\n| State | Input mode, selected basename, as-of/basis, fingerprint (safe projection) | `RunContext` |\n| Current task | The run's instruction to produce a rating + decision | node prompt |\n\n### Context assembly pipeline (application-bound)\n`deduplicate → prioritize (identity/constraints first) → budget (per-agent token cap) → compact (summarize low-priority narrative; never drop mode/snapshot identity/output authority/critical constraints) → assemble (final prompt)`.\n\n#### Operational budget and compaction design (B3-07, F6; proposed, unmeasured)\nAll numbers are **proposed design values (ESTIMATE)**, not measured. C/D later verify/measure.\n\n- **Estimator:** token counts approximated by `ceil(len(prompt_chars)/4)` (cheap, provider-agnostic; **explicitly estimated**, no guarantee against provider tokenizer; no tokenizer dependency added).\n- **Per-agent context cap** `C_cap = 24,000` estimated tokens (proposed): bounds the **assembled prompt context** for one agent, not an aggregate run budget.\n- **Critical reserve** `R_reserve = 4,000` estimated tokens (proposed) planned for identity + standing constraints + state/authority + frozen notice/disclaimer; never compacted.\n- **Compaction threshold** `T_compact = floor(0.8 · C_cap) = floor(19,200) = 19,200`; compact when estimated context exceeds `T_compact`; hard stop at `C_cap`. (Arithmetic corrected: 0.8 × 24,000 = **19,200**, not 20,000.)\n- **Protected-context overflow (actual estimate, not the constant):** let `P` be the **measured estimate of the protected layers** (identity + constraints + state/authority + notice/disclaimer) at assembly time. If `P + (minimum irreducible task/history context) > C_cap`, or more simply if `P > C_cap − C_min_task` (where `C_min_task` is the minimum needed for the current task), **fail closed** (typed `INTERNAL_ERROR`, redacted). The guard compares the **actual protected estimate `P`**, never merely `R_reserve` (which by construction is ≤ `C_cap` and could never overflow).\n- **Compaction termination:** compaction reduces only low-priority narrative (debate prose, redundant analyst text) until total ≤ `T_compact` or until the only remaining reducible content is protected; if compacting all reducible narrative still leaves total > `C_cap`, **fail closed**. Available narrative budget = `C_cap − P`; stop when narrative reaches that bound.\n- **Compaction method:** summarize/trim **low-priority narrative layers only**; deterministic truncation with an explicit \"(compacted)\" marker is the baseline. If a summarizing **model call** is used it is an **explicitly disclosed extra provider call** logged as `event=context.compact` — not silent network behaviour. Default design = deterministic truncation (no extra model; consistent with the note that these corrections imply **no new summarizing provider call**).\n- **Re-injection:** after compaction re-inject identity, mode, snapshot identity (fingerprint/basename/as-of), output authority and frozen disclaimer/notice.\n- **Where:** node-prompt assembly in the agent context layer (`tradingagents/agents/context.py` + prompt builders); **not** OpenCode's internal context.\n- **Temporal guards:** memory/context retrieval keeps upstream as-of/time guards; compaction must not reintroduce out-of-window history.\n- **Illustrative over-cap (document example; arithmetic verified):** assembled estimate = 26,000 tokens; protected `P ≈ 3,200` (identity/constraints/state/notice). Reducible narrative ≈ 22,800. Compaction truncates older bull/bear debate prose (~6,500 → ~500, saving ~6,000) giving 26,000 − 6,000 = **20,000**, still > `T_compact`=19,200, so further low-priority narrative is trimmed (e.g., another ~800) to reach ≈ **19,200** ≤ `T_compact`; protected `P` and current task survive. 1: # ADR 001 — Portfolio-aware CLI: input/service boundary and consent
2: 
3: - Status: **Proposed (architecture draft)**. Selection made by Brian (human) 2026-11-12; awaiting team/instructor reconciliation. Not implementation.
4: - Deciders: Brian (selection), Member B (author), pending A (requirements coherence), E (governance/assembly).
5: - Scope: `SEL-TA-FR-001..007`, `SEL-TA-NFR-001..006`, `SEL-TA-GOV-006` (permission design contribution).
6: - Supersedes: none. Does not modify v2 requirements or the D1 registry (A owns).
7: 
8: > Estimates in this ADR are labelled **ESTIMATE** and are design judgements. No measurement or verification is claimed.
9: 
10: ## Context
11: 
12: TradingAgents v0.7.1 already has an optional `--portfolio PATH` that loads a `PortfolioContext` and renders it into decision-agent prompts (`cli/main.py:50-55`, `tradingagents/portfolio.py`, `tradingagents/graph/trading_graph.py:293-307`). The selected requirements extend this into a discovery + explicit-consent + frozen-provenance + deterministic-check workflow, with distinct `NO_PORTFOLIO`/`PORTFOLIO_PROVIDED` semantics. The course additionally requires a **layered agent context** design, context assembly and compaction constraints, which this ADR records.
13: 
14: Constraints from the current selection (treated as fixed working decisions): CLI-only UI; `PORTFOLIO_DIR=<root>/portfolios`; `--without-portfolio`; `--portfolio-as-of`; consent behaviour; full normalized-content SHA-256 fingerprint; no silent fallback; no invented zero holdings/cash; model cannot assign checks.
15: 
16: ## Course-required layered context (design)
17: 
18: | Layer | Content (bounded application context) | Source |
19: |---|---|---|
20: | Identity | Instrument/ticker + resolved identity context | `agents/context.py:build_instrument_context` |
21: | Standing constraints | Advisory-only role; no execution; rating vocabulary; disclaimer requirement; "no account ownership assumed" | prompts + frozen strings |
22: | Knowledge | Analyst reports, research/trader plans, risk debate | graph state |
23: | History | Memory-log lessons from prior decisions | `tradingagents/memory/` |
24: | State | Input mode, selected basename, as-of/basis, fingerprint (safe projection) | `RunContext` |
25: | Current task | The run's instruction to produce a rating + decision | node prompt |
26: 
27: ### Context assembly pipeline (application-bound)
28: `deduplicate → prioritize (identity/constraints first) → budget (per-agent token cap) → compact (summarize low-priority narrative; never drop mode/snapshot identity/output authority/critical constraints) → assemble (final prompt)`.
29: 
30: #### Operational budget and compaction design (B3-07, F6; proposed, unmeasured)
31: All numbers are **proposed design values (ESTIMATE)**, not measured. C/D later verify/measure.
32: 
33: - **Estimator:** token counts approximated by `ceil(len(prompt_chars)/4)` (cheap, provider-agnostic; **explicitly estimated**, no guarantee against provider tokenizer; no tokenizer dependency added).
34: - **Per-agent context cap** `C_cap = 24,000` estimated tokens (proposed): bounds the **assembled prompt context** for one agent, not an aggregate run budget.
35: - **Critical reserve** `R_reserve = 4,000` estimated tokens (proposed) planned for identity + standing constraints + state/authority + frozen notice/disclaimer; never compacted.
36: - **Compaction threshold** `T_compact = floor(0.8 · C_cap) = floor(19,200) = 19,200`; compact when estimated context exceeds `T_compact`; hard stop at `C_cap`. (Arithmetic corrected: 0.8 × 24,000 = **19,200**, not 20,000.)
37: - **Protected-context overflow (actual estimate, not the constant):** let `P` be the **measured estimate of the protected layers** (identity + constraints + state/authority + notice/disclaimer) at assembly time. If `P + (minimum irreducible task/history context) > C_cap`, or more simply if `P > C_cap − C_min_task` (where `C_min_task` is the minimum needed for the current task), **fail closed** (typed `INTERNAL_ERROR`, redacted). The guard compares the **actual protected estimate `P`**, never merely `R_reserve` (which by construction is ≤ `C_cap` and could never overflow).
38: - **Compaction termination:** compaction reduces only low-priority narrative (debate prose, redundant analyst text) until total ≤ `T_compact` or until the only remaining reducible content is protected; if compacting all reducible narrative still leaves total > `C_cap`, **fail closed**. Available narrative budget = `C_cap − P`; stop when narrative reaches that bound.
39: - **Compaction method:** summarize/trim **low-priority narrative layers only**; deterministic truncation with an explicit "(compacted)" marker is the baseline. If a summarizing **model call** is used it is an **explicitly disclosed extra provider call** logged as `event=context.compact` — not silent network behaviour. Default design = deterministic truncation (no extra model; consistent with the note that these corrections imply **no new summarizing provider call**).
40: - **Re-injection:** after compaction re-inject identity, mode, snapshot identity (fingerprint/basename/as-of), output authority and frozen disclaimer/notice.
41: - **Where:** node-prompt assembly in the agent context layer (`tradingagents/agents/context.py` + prompt builders); **not** OpenCode's internal context.
42: - **Temporal guards:** memory/context retrieval keeps upstream as-of/time guards; compaction must not reintroduce out-of-window history.
43: - **Illustrative over-cap (document example; arithmetic verified):** assembled estimate = 26,000 tokens; protected `P ≈ 3,200` (identity/constraints/state/notice). Reducible narrative ≈ 22,800. Compaction truncates older bull/bear debate prose (~6,500 → ~500, saving ~6,000) giving 26,000 − 6,000 = **20,000**, still > `T_compact`=19,200, so further low-priority narrative is trimmed (e.g., another ~800) to reach ≈ **19,200** ≤ `T_compact`; protected `P` and current task survive. If instead `P` were 23,000, then `C_cap − P = 1,000` narrative budget, and it fails closed when the minimum task context cannot fit.
44: - **Distinction:** bounded **application-context** design; not OpenCode internal management; **not** an aggregate run-token/time/call budget (deferred).
45: 
46: ## Decision
47: 
48: Adopt **C2: an input-service + deeply immutable `RunContext` boundary with a small explicit CLI lifecycle coordinator and a shared execution service.**
49: 
50: - `PortfolioInputService` (`tradingagents/runapi/input_service.py`): the sole discoverer/validator/freezer; produces a `RunContext`.
51: - `RunContext`/`FrozenSnapshot` (`runapi/context.py`): deeply immutable value tuples + mode + full-64 canonical SHA-256 + as-of/basis + consent_state; read-only provenance source.
52: - **Shared execution service** (`runapi/execution.py: run_analysis_api`): the **common application entry** for CLI and supported project API; rejects non-`CONFIRMED` contexts; owns execution, exception mapping, checks, finalize, staging/publish and terminal event; prompt-free.
53: - `RunLifecycleCoordinator` (CLI layer): interactive selection/consent transitions; no LLM; no broad orchestration rewrite; no backtest/resume.
54: - `OutputChecker` and `OutcomeFinalizer` are the sole assigners of `output_check`/`run_outcome`.
55: - Upstream engine signature preserved; the raw primitive is a declared reduced-coverage path whose product reliance requires A's approval (R-API).
56: 
57: ## Alternatives considered (actual, preserved)
58: 
59: - **C1 — Minimal baseline extension.** Inline discovery/validation (sole shared module, thin inline adapter); header lines appended in reporting; small checker; inline manifest. Pros: smallest footprint. Cons: lifecycle sequencing inline; higher risk of provenance drift if reporting re-derives from `final_state` (latent FR-006/007 risk); weakest typed failure behaviour. Score 3.30.
60: - **C2 — Input-service + `RunContext` + small coordinator + shared execution service (selected).** Pros: explicit input/snapshot boundary; clean test seams; shared provenance; typed outcomes; full-coverage API path. Cons: more modules than C1. Score 4.65.
61: - **C3 — Phased single-run orchestrator façade.** Same service/context, plus a façade over the whole single-run lifecycle. Pros: strong phase testing. Cons: broader `cli/run.py` change; highest coupling/surface; scope-creep risk. Score 3.75.
62: 
63: ## Human selection rationale (recorded verbatim in substance)
64: 
65: Brian selected **C2** because of its **explicit input/snapshot boundary, test seams and shared provenance, without C3's broader orchestration change.** This is a **human design choice based on estimated tradeoffs**, explicitly **not** a claim of verified superiority.
66: 
67: ## Consequences
68: 
69: Positive: single provenance source; deterministic check authority; consent is an explicit transition; shared execution service gives full-coverage API path; preserved engine signature.
70: Negative/risks: the raw low-level engine primitive can bypass the boundary and its product use requires A's approval (R-API); full-64 fingerprint canonicalization must be exactly implemented (`interface-contracts.md` §2.2); prompt/context wording changes are required (not optional).
71: 
72: ## Reopening conditions
73: 
74: - Instructor mandates a single orchestration façade → revisit C3.
75: - File-count/scope constraints favour C1 → revisit.
76: - Real test evidence (C) shows C1's inline path is cleanly testable with no provenance drift → re-score.
77: - Any change to consent semantics, provenance identity or check authority requires a new ADR.
78: 
79: ## Related
80:

49: class PromptCapture(BaseCallbackHandler):
50:     """Records the *shape* of each model call, never its body.
51: 
52:     ``on_chat_model_start``/``on_llm_start`` fire once per model invocation.
53:     We keep a per-call fingerprint (sha256 of the concatenated prompt), the
54:     total character length, the message count, and which challenge markers the
55:     prompt contained. This is enough to prove a challenge reached model input
56:     without storing the raw prompt.
57:     """
58: 
59:     def __init__(self, markers: tuple[str, ...] = ()):
60:         super().__init__()
61:         self.markers = markers
62:         self.calls: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
63:         self._marker_hits: dict[str, int] = dict.fromkeys(markers, 0)
64: 
65:     def _record(self, texts: list[str]) -> None:
66:         joined = "\n\n".join(texts)
67:         digest = hashlib.sha256(joined.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
68:         hits = {marker: joined.count(marker) for marker in self.markers}
69:         for marker, count in hits.items():
70:             self._marker_hits[marker] += count
71:         self.calls.append({
72:             "prompt_sha256": digest,
73:             "prompt_chars": len(joined),
74:             "messages": len(texts),
75:             "marker_hits": hits,
76:         })
77: 
78:     def on_chat_model_start(self, serialized, messages, **kwargs):  # noqa: D401
79:         texts: list[str] = []
80:         for batch in messages:
81:             for message in batch:
82:                 content = getattr(message, "content", "")
83:                 if isinstance(content, list):
84:                     text = " ".join(
85:                         part.get("text", "") if isinstance(part, dict) else str(part)
86:                         for part in content
87:                     )
88:                 else:
89:                     text = str(content)
90:                 texts.append(text)
91:         self._record(texts)
92: 
93:     def on_llm_start(self, serialized, prompts, **kwargs):
94:         self._record([str(prompt) for prompt in prompts])
95: 
96:     def summary(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
97:         return {
98:             "model_calls": len(self.calls),
99:             "calls": list(self.calls),
100:             "prompt_chars_total": sum(call["prompt_chars"] for call in self.calls),
101:             # Distinct prompt digests let a reader confirm the calls differed,
102:             # without exposing any body.
103:             "distinct_prompt_digests": sorted({call["prompt_sha256"] for call in self.calls}),
104:             "marker_hits_total": dict(self._marker_hits),
105:             "marker_reached_model": {
106:                 marker: hits > 0 for marker, hits in self._marker_hits.items()
107:             },
108:         }

        "text": "\"\"\"Trader: turns the Research Manager's investment plan into a concrete transaction proposal.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom langchain_core.messages import AIMessage\n\nfrom tradingagents.agents.context import (\n    get_instrument_context_from_state,\n    get_language_instruction,\n    get_portfolio_context_from_state,\n    protect_context,\n)\nfrom tradingagents.agents.schemas import TraderProposal, render_trader_proposal\nfrom tradingagents.agents.structured import (\n    NO_EXTERNAL_TOOLS,\n    bind_structured,\n    invoke_structured_or_freetext,\n)\n\n\ndef create_trader(llm):\n    structured_llm = bind_structured(llm, TraderProposal, \"Trader\")\n\n    def trader_node(state):\n        company_name = state[\"company_of_interest\"]\n        instrument_context = protect_context(get_instrument_context_from_state(state))\n        investment_plan = state[\"investment_plan\"]\n        # The research plan digests the debate but loses exact price structure;\n        # give the Trader the technical market report so entry/stop levels are\n        # grounded in real ATR / support-resistance / current price (#1167). The\n        # report is empty when the user did not select the market analyst, so\n        # only offer it (and the grounding instruction) when it has content.\n        market_report = (state[\"market_report\"] or \"\").strip()\n        portfolio_context = protect_context(get_portfolio_context_from_state(state))\n\n        if market_report:\n            grounding = (\n                \"Ground concrete price levels (entry, stop-loss, position sizing) in the technical \"\n                \"market report's price structure -- current price, support/resistance, ATR, and \"\n                \"volatility -- and use the research plan for direction and strategy. \"\n            )\n            report_section = f\"Technical Market Report:\\n{market_report}\\n\\n\"\n        else:\n            grounding = \"\"\n            report_section = \"\"\n\n        messages = [\n            {\n                \"role\": \"system\",\n                \"content\": (\n                    \"You are a trading agent analyzing market data to make investment decisions. \"\n                    \"Based on your analysis, provide a specific recommendation to buy, sell, or hold. \"\n                    + grounding\n                    # Entry/stop are numeric price fields. Asking for concrete\n                    # levels invites a percentage (\"15%\"), which is not a price\n                    # and fails the structured parse (#1288).\n                    + \"State entry price and stop-loss as absolute price levels in the \"\n                    \"instrument's quote currency (for example 189.5), never a percentage \"\n                    \"or a range; convert a percentage distance to the price level it \"\n                    \"implies, or omit the field if you cannot state a number. \"\n                    + NO_EXTERNAL_TOOLS\n                    + get_language_instruction()\n                ),\n            },\n            {\n                \"role\": \"user\",\n                \"content\": (\n                    f\"Here is the research team's investment plan for {company_name}. \"\n                    f\"{instrument_context}\\n\\n\"\n                    f\"{report_section}\"\n                    f\"{portfolio_context}\\n\\n\"\n                    f\"Proposed Investment Plan:\\n{investment_plan}\\n\\n\"\n                    \"Make an informed, strategic trading decision.\\n\\n\"\n                    \"## Output\\n\\n\"\n                    \"Write these sections, in this order, starting with the action \"\n                    \"on its own line:\\n\\n\"\n                    \"- **Action**: exactly one of Buy / Hold / Sell. A research \"\n                    \"recommendation of Overweight is a Buy and Underweight is a Sell, \"\n                    \"sized by how strong the case is; conflict alone is not a Hold. \"\n                    \"Sell is directional research guidance: without a supplied long position it means \"\n                    \"avoid entry, not liquidate assumed holdings. The supplied portfolio facts override \"\n                    \"ownership assumptions in the investment plan.\\n\"\n                    \"- **Reasoning**: why, against the plan and the price structure\\n\"\n                    \"- **Entry Price**, **Stop Loss**, **Position Sizing**: when you can state them\"\n                ),\n            },\n        ]\n\n        trader_plan = invoke_structured_or_freetext(\n            structured_llm,\n            llm,\n            messages,\n            render_trader_proposal,\n            \"Trader\",\n        )\n\n        return {\n            \"messages\": [AIMessage(content=trader_plan)],\n            \"trader_investment_plan\": trader_plan,\n        }\n\n    return trader_node",

        "text": "\"\"\"GOV-004 live replay configuration.\n\nThis directory now lives under ``tests/`` (the configured ``testpaths``), so the\nupstream ``tests/conftest.py`` applies to it. That upstream conftest blanks every\n``TRADINGAGENTS_*`` setting and blocks sockets for tests not marked\n``integration`` — exactly what a live run must NOT do. This conftest neutralises\nthose two behaviours for the ``live`` suite while keeping them for everything\nelse here.\n\nTwo suites live in this directory:\n\n* ``offline`` behaviours and ``test_harness_selfcheck.py`` -- offline, scripted\n  model, no network. Always runnable and collected by the default suite.\n* ``test_gov004_live.py`` -- the real live replay. It runs only when the\n  operator opts in explicitly (``GOV004_LIVE=1``); otherwise it is skipped, so an\n  accidental full-suite invocation never spends provider budget or touches the\n  network.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport os\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\n\n_REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]\n\n\ndef pytest_configure(config):\n    for marker in (\"unit\", \"integration\", \"smoke\", \"live\"):\n        config.addinivalue_line(\"markers\", f\"{marker}: {marker}-level tests\")\n    config.addinivalue_line(\n        \"markers\", \"live: makes real provider calls; requires GOV004_LIVE=1\"\n    )\n\n\ndef live_enabled() -> bool:\n    return os.getenv(\"GOV004_LIVE\", \"\").strip() == \"1\"\n\n\n@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)\ndef _no_network(request, monkeypatch):\n    \"\"\"Override the upstream socket block for ``live`` tests.\n\n    The upstream ``tests/conftest.py`` defines this autouse fixture to refuse all\n    sockets. 22: def test_concurrent_publish_collision_preserves_owner(tmp_path):
23:     staged, release = Event(), Event()
24: 
25:     class BlockingRedactor(Redactor):
26:         def scrub(self, value):
27:             staged.set()
28:             assert release.wait(10)
29:             return super().scrub(value)

31:     def publish(redactor):

33:             tmp_path, "AAPL", "shared", "report", None, {}, EventSink("shared", "AAPL"), redactor

36:     with ThreadPoolExecutor() as pool:
37:         owner = pool.submit(publish, BlockingRedactor())
38:         assert staged.wait(10)
39:         try:
40:             with pytest.raises(PersistenceError):
41:                 publish(Redactor())

43:         finally:
