        "text": "# R1–R5 remediation — implementation and verification record (2026-11-21)\n\nPrepared 2026-11-21, Asia/Hong_Kong. Baseline `9b04330`. Implemented by the OpenCode repair session under the approval recorded in [the R1–R5 test plan](../verification/proposals/remediation-r1-r5-test-plan-2026-11-21.md). This record reports actual offline results only; it is **not** independent/formal acceptance, **not** a provider/model semantic PASS, and does **not** recover F8 historical evidence.\n\nSource findings: [follow-up review](remediation-follow-up-review-2026-11-21.md) residual R1–R5. Independent black-box review passes reproduced residual defects; each was fixed with a regression test first. See “Second pass”, “Final pass”, and “Final correction (pending eligibility)” below.\n\n## Scope kept\n\nBounded repairs to the intended contracts. No edits to unsent `docs/planning/`, the final-readiness audit drafts, approved test-plan criteria, canonical requirements/proposals, CI/governance, `.env`, credentials, private live evidence or raw exports. Public contracts preserved: two input modes, five research ratings, Trader's three actions, Q1–Q4 authority, frozen snapshot/fingerprint, report+manifest critical and terminal-append best-effort, unchanged formal provider/thresholds. No commits, pushes, live/model calls or dependency changes. Offline tests use fake models, synthetic credentials/portfolios, `tmp_path` and no network.\n\nR1–R5 numbering here is distinct from the older F1–F9 review items.\n\n## What changed\n\n| Item | Production/tooling change | Tests |\n|---|---|---|\n| **R1** | `agents/structured.py` binding/invocation warnings pass the exception through the shared `Redactor`; redactor-construction failure degrades safely. `agents/context.py` identity debug sink redacted identically | `test_r1_logging_redaction.py` |\n| **R2** | `score_gov004.py`: trusted facts from authoritative `cases.py`; cohort-bound controls; conditional/presence/type checks; manifest `schema_version`; resolved-path consistency; case identity incl. `portfolio_kind`; mirror/batch equality; fence/quote-aware envelope parser rejecting counterfeit metadata | `test_r2_scorer_correspondence.py`, `test_r2_real_renderer.py`, `test_r2_r3_differential_pins.py` |\n| **R3** | `replay_store.py`: versioned ledger + per-attempt files; `flock`-guarded claim/update; `validate_run_id` + containment/identity/overwrite; interruption propagation; truthful pending metadata with pre-dispatch config/controls; absent-file-only means “no ledger”, empty/malformed fails closed. Live runner validates the whole cohort before dispatch; scorer ingests/validates pending starts; exporter handles the ledger | `test_r3_replay_durability.py` |\n| **R4** | `research_manager.py` receives the protected portfolio block; `portfolio.py render()` states the facts are user-supplied and unverified; truthful RM comment | `test_r4_research_manager_context.py` |\n| **R5** | `events.py` private tentative terminal; `commit_terminal` sets single-terminal state; `build_terminal`. `persist.py` stages before commit; the single rename is authoritative; caller-terminal reveal is a post-commit best-effort callback; legacy sinks get truthful `durable` | `test_r5_terminal_visibility.py` |\n\n## Second pass\nR5 double-terminal; R3 unlocked claim and unsafe `record_outcome` path; R3 exporter `KeyError`; R3 interruption caught inside `run_case`; R2 hardcoded date/duplicate portfolio map; R2 resolved-path/missing-key; R1 unasserted canaries + context sink; R4 unverified wording. Each had a failing regression before the fix.\n\n## Final pass\n1. **R2 mirror conflict** — dedup only identical complete rows after JSON parsing; conflicting copies fail regardless of filename ordering, including single-field conflicts.\n2. **R2 schema/counterfeit** — completed manifests must carry a supported `schema_version`; required keys present even when null; a bare unquoted authoritative-looking line after the body is rejected by a line/fence/quote-aware rule while quoted/fenced narrative is accepted.\n3. **R3 ledger** — only an absent `gov004_starts.json` means “no evidence”; `{}`/`null`/`[]`/wrong-schema/malformed/duplicate/unsafe records fail closed.\n4. **R3 interruptions** — `run_case` re-raises `KeyboardInterrupt`/`SystemExit`; `dispatch_slots` also stops on an application-reported `INTERRUPTED` result; verified through the real wiring with no second call.\n5. **R5 legacy durability** — a genuine old-signature sink yields a terminal row with a valid timestamp (or honest `durable=false`), never false `durable=true`.\n6. **R5 post-commit callback** — a raising `commit_terminal()` after the rename keeps the published COMPLETED result and immutable manifest; pre-commit critical failures remain PERSISTENCE_ERROR.\n7. **R2 live cohort preflight** — the live runner validates the full frozen cohort (schema v2 controls/slots/IDs, fixed config, selected ticker/date) before any graph call; declared date `2025-12-19` remains usable.\n8. **Cleanup** — removed the `/tmp` baseline import from permanent tests and the vacuous `test_r1_r5_smoke.py`.\n\n## Final correction (pending eligibility)\n\nAn independent probe showed `no_bad_evidence = all(a.eligible or a.pending_start ...)` let a pending start bypass eligibility, so 10 completed + 1 defective pending still PASSed. Corrected minimally:\n\n- Acceptance now requires **every** started attempt to be eligible; there is no `or pending_start` exception. 3. **Truthful preflight** — `validate_formal_cohort` now requires declared schema fields and validates safe run IDs, ISO analysis date, timezone-aware non-future freeze, revision/prompt-hash shape, full slot coverage, with non-echoing diagnostics. Both `2025-12-19` and `2026-01-09` remain usable.
4. **Safe backend identifier** — `_model_config_from_env` records only the parsed hostname (`urlsplit().hostname`), excluding `user:password@`, port, path, query; malformed URL → `None`. Tests assert no userinfo/query survives serialization.

## Honest limits / not claimed
Offline harness/config tests only. Genuine control-bound 9 completed + 1 pending still passes at ≥9/10 and ≥90%.\n - **R1 named-sink coverage is bounded** to the inspected callsites.\n - **F8** and formal provider/model semantic acceptance remain pending and were not manufactured.\n \n No unresolved code blockers for the approved offline scope.\n \n ## Supervising reviewer verification\n \n After OpenCode finished, the supervising Codex reviewer independently exercised the real application boundary with fake engines and temporary synthetic artifacts. A valid ten-completed population passed; nine completed plus one correctly bound pending start also passed (9/10 completion, scores only for the nine completed reports). Missing required manifest fields/schema, conflicting durability mirrors, counterfeit unquoted result metadata, unknown pending configuration and a wrong pending provider were rejected. The rejection and start ledger survived portable export/rescoring from a different working directory.\n \n Independent process probes confirmed one winner for a duplicate run ID and all ten distinct simultaneous claims retained. Unsafe output paths and an empty malformed ledger were rejected. Through the actual runner, both a raised interruption and a returned INTERRUPTED outcome stopped subsequent dispatch. Legacy terminal durability and a post-publication callback failure returned outcomes consistent with the immutable manifest. These offline reviewer probes are separate from Member C's course acceptance and live semantic judgments.\n \n The set-aside work plan and readiness drafts match their pre-implementation hashes; relative links in the repair documents resolve. Baseline HEAD remains `9b04330`; the repaired working tree is uncommitted. No commits, pushes or application live-model calls were made. Existing private evidence and credentials were not edited.\n \n The [full available OpenCode interaction](../../AI-log/Member-B/2026-11-21_16-17-01.md) preserves all 475 native messages and attached instruction texts, with sharing redactions and superseded intermediate claims retained. The unmodified native export is retained privately under `.local-review/remediation-r1-r5-20261121T081527Z/`; its SHA-256 is `ac3f0ae0c113b97ae170a50b93db3b098c4f4f48d58713f05894e928a451df6a`. This is one authentic implementation session for later D5 assembly, not a claim that D5 is complete.\n",

        "file": "docs/verification/gov004-evidence-package.md",
        "patch": "Index: docs/verification/gov004-evidence-package.md\n===================================================================\n--- docs/verification/gov004-evidence-package.md\t\n+++ docs/verification/gov004-evidence-package.md\t\n@@ -1,77 +1,77 @@\n # GOV004 portable evidence and frozen population\n \n The November 18 historical live PASS remains **PENDING independent audit**: the original reports, manifests and score file are not present in this checkout. Repairing the scorer or creating fresh diagnostics cannot recover or approve those historical judgments. Preserve the original review and do not fabricate missing scores, timestamps or approval.\n \n ## Freeze a formal cohort before outcomes\n \n A/C must approve the actual provider/model configuration, applicability and critical-item policy before formal use. The scorer retains the documented fixed `deepseek` configuration; the saved school `openai_compatible` configuration is diagnostic until that difference is explicitly approved. Critical R1/R2/R3/R5/R6/R7 failures conservatively prevent PASS, regardless of optional caller flags. A/C should ratify this explicit policy rather than infer safety from a missing flag.\n \n Create `tests/member_c_verification/live/evidence/cohort.json` with:\n \n - `schema_version`: integer **2**. Schema 2 newly makes `ticker`/`analysis_date` mandatory; schema 1 is treated as stale and rejected (it is not silently upgraded).\n - `approved_by`: attributable real approver, never a generated identity.\n - `frozen_at_utc`: actual timezone-aware freeze timestamp, before the recorded run start.\n - `source_revision`: exact revision label, including `+dirty` where applicable.\n - `prompt_hash`: the application's full SHA256 prompt-source hash.\n - `ticker` and `analysis_date`: the **analysis controls** every formal attempt used. The live runner validates these (and the fixed configuration) against the selected run **before any graph call**, spending zero calls on a mismatch, and the scorer binds expected identity to them. A supported declared date (e.g. `2025-12-19`) is usable and is never inferred from a (possibly corrupt) manifest.\n - `members`: exactly ten objects with `case_id`, `trial` (`1` or `2`) and unique preallocated safe `run_id`. Each fixed case has one slot per trial.\n \n A full cohort that is malformed, stale or unsupported is rejected before dispatch. Expected per-case portfolio facts and `portfolio_kind` are derived from the authoritative `cases.py`, not duplicated in the scorer, so the definitions cannot drift.\n \n Retain the approval and cohort externally or in version control before execution; editable local timestamps alone cannot prove historical chronology. The application and capture harness record hashes, but that is not a digital signature or a substitute for review.\n \n Set `GOV004_TRIAL=1` or `2` for approved formal replay. The harness reads the cohort, uses its run IDs and refuses to reuse a started slot. A diagnostic run leaves the trial unset. Store diagnostic evidence separately from formal evidence. Every recorded formal start remains in overall completion accounting; retries do not replace failed cohort slots. Completion is reported separately from semantic scores on eligible completed reports.\n \n ### Isolated evidence root and live provider selection\n \n - **Isolation.** Both the scorer and the live replay honour `GOV004_EVIDENCE_DIR`. Point it at a fresh directory to replay without mixing old private pilot files; the replay writes `gov004_<stamp>.json`, its run tree, and the start ledger under that root, and `runner.outcome_to_dict(outcome, evidence_root=...)` records relative paths and hashes against it (an artifact outside the root is rejected). Example:\n \n   ```sh\n   GOV004_LIVE=1 GOV004_EVIDENCE_DIR=/tmp/gov004-live GOV004_TRIAL=1 \\\n     GOV004_TICKER=AAPL GOV004_DATE=2026-01-09 \\\n     .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/member_c_verification/live/test_gov004_live.py -p no:cacheprovider -q -s\n   ```\n \n-- **Live provider override.** A narrowly-scoped `GOV004_LLM_PROVIDER` override is applied *after* the saved `.env` settings are restored. It sets the base provider and both model tiers consistently, so the recorded config equals the adapters actually used. When unset, the saved settings are used unchanged. It never copies or migrates credentials (the caller supplies the provider's normal credential env var privately) and never lowers thresholds. Example: `GOV004_LLM_PROVIDER=deepseek` selects `deepseek` with model `CS5351/DeepSeek-V4-Flash` for both tiers; the provider/model/date remain validated against the fixed formal config and the frozen cohort.\n+- **Live provider override.** A narrowly-scoped `GOV004_LLM_PROVIDER` override is applied *after* the saved `.env` settings are restored. It changes the **provider only**: it sets the base provider and aligns both tier providers to it (so the effective adapter for every tier is the requested provider), and it does **not** rewrite the model IDs. Saved or caller-selected model IDs still reach the strict fixed-config validation, so a wrong model ID causes **zero** dispatch rather than being silently converted to a valid one. When unset, the saved settings are used unchanged. It never copies or migrates credentials (the caller supplies the provider's normal credential env var privately) and never lowers thresholds. Example: `GOV004_LLM_PROVIDER=deepseek` selects the `deepseek` provider/adapter for the base and both tiers; the model IDs from the saved/selected config (e.g. `CS5351/DeepSeek-V4-Flash`) are still validated against the fixed formal config.\n \n - **Truthful preflight.** Before any graph call the live runner validates the *entire* frozen cohort: schema 2 controls, safe run IDs, an ISO analysis date, a timezone-aware non-future `frozen_at_utc`, a revision/prompt-hash of the right shape, full slot coverage, the selected ticker/date and the fixed config. It also compares the declared `source_revision`/`prompt_hash` with the actual current source inventory (injectable for offline tests). A missing/malformed/stale/mismatching cohort spends **zero** calls and records no started run. Diagnostics never echo field values. The approval text is attributable caller authorization, separate from C's independent acceptance.\n \n - **Safe backend identifier.** The recorded `backend_host` is the URL's hostname only (via a real parser): `user:password@`, port, path and query are never persisted, and a malformed URL records `None`.\n \n Set `GOV004_TRIAL=1` or `2` for approved formal replay. The harness reads the cohort, uses its run IDs and refuses to reuse a started slot. A diagnostic run leaves the trial unset. Store diagnostic evidence separately from formal evidence.\n \n ## Record evidence and human scores\n \n The capture harness records portable relative report and manifest paths and their SHA256 digests. Manifests must match the run identity, result, source revision, fixed configuration, prompt hash and report path. Each report must contain the corresponding trusted Run ID header. A completed record needs all of this evidence; incomplete/error attempts remain counted even without completed artifacts.\n \n ### Case/provenance/report correspondence (R2)\n \n A complete set of score cells is not sufficient. The scorer now validates each completed attempt against the trusted frozen case definition, not against the attempt's own (possibly defective) record:\n \n - **Result conditions.** `COMPLETED` requires a valid rating, `stop_reason=null`, and `PASSED`/`NEEDS_REVIEW`; `REVIEW` requires `NEEDS_REVIEW`; `PASSED` carries no findings and `NEEDS_REVIEW` carries at least one valid Q1–Q4/`CHECK_ERROR` finding. A non-completed attempt carries no rating, a known stop reason, `NOT_RUN` and no findings.\n - **Case identity and analysis controls.** `ticker`, `analysis_date`, `input_mode`, `basename`, `fingerprint_sha256`, `portfolio_as_of` and `as_of_basis` must equal the values derived from the declared fixed case (from the authoritative `cases.py` via `expected_case_identity`, bound to the cohort controls). Expected input facts are never inferred from the manifest itself, so a held-target file substituted for the explicit-empty case, a `NO_PORTFOLIO` label on an explicit-empty case, or a wrong `portfolio_kind` fails even with recomputed hashes. Required manifest keys must be **present** even when their value is legitimately null (missing ≠ explicit null), and the manifest `schema_version` must be the supported application version.\n - **Authoritative report envelope.** The contiguous leading header block of `complete_report.md` (title, then the `- Key: value` lines, then `Findings:`) must agree with the manifest/record for run ID, ticker, analysis date, input mode, portfolio file, fingerprint, as-of/basis, run outcome, stop reason, final rating and output check. A missing, duplicate or conflicting authoritative field fails. Quoted (`>`), fenced (```) or later narrative that references a status is not treated as the authoritative block; a **bare, unquoted** authoritative-looking `- Key: value` line outside the header is rejected by a line/fence/quote-aware rule (not a global substring search).\n - **Durability mirror equality.** A per-attempt `gov004_attempt_<run_id>.json` mirror may repeat a run already counted from a batch file **only** when it is identical after parsing (full-row equality). A conflicting copy fails regardless of filename ordering; two genuinely independent attempts sharing a run ID still fail.\n \n Legacy formal evidence that lacks these fields is rejected rather than having the missing fields fabricated. This binds artifacts to the declared case; it does not cryptographically prove the honesty of a human score.\n \n ### Durable per-attempt accounting (R3)\n \n `tests/member_c_verification/live/replay_store.py` makes every attempt durable on its own. Before dispatch the whole selected cohort is preflighted (unique run IDs, one slot per case/trial, none already started); nothing runs on failure, and the live runner validates the frozen cohort controls/config first. Each slot is claimed (`STARTED`) in the versioned `gov004_starts.json` (schema 2) *before* `run_case` is called, carrying the pre-dispatch `model_config` and `controls` (ticker, analysis date, source revision, prompt hash), and its outcome is written to its own `gov004_attempt_<run_id>.json` (validated and confined to the evidence root), so two starts in one second cannot overwrite and a later failure cannot discard an earlier attempt. Only an **absent** ledger means “no evidence”: an empty/malformed/duplicate/unsafe ledger fails closed. `KeyboardInterrupt`/`SystemExit`, and an application-reported `INTERRUPTED` result, stop further dispatch after the current start/outcome is preserved.\n \n A retained pending start is an **eligible**, noncompleted denominator entry only when its pre-dispatch binding is trusted and complete: a known fixed configuration and captured controls that match the frozen cohort (ticker, analysis date, and — where declared — source revision and prompt hash). A missing, unknown or mismatching binding is **ineligible yet still counted in the denominator**; it is never a completed quality sample, and model settings are never fabricated from a result. Acceptance requires **every** started attempt (completed or pending) to be eligible, so a wrongly-configured pending start blocks a PASS even when all completed rows are excellent (e.g. 10 completed + 1 defective pending → 10/11 ≥ 90% but FAIL). A genuine control-bound 9 completed + 1 pending (9/10 = 90%, ≥9 completed, ≥1 completed per case) passes at the unchanged thresholds. Reusing a started slot is refused. Diagnostics/pilot populations remain separate from the formal cohort.\n \n The score JSON contains a real `reviewer` and an `answers` list. Each applicable answer has `case_id`, `run_id`, `trial`, `item`, integer `score` (0 or 1), and a nonempty `citation` found in that run's report. Record rationale and disagreements alongside it. Do not submit N/A rows for inapplicable cells. The scorer derives applicability; missing, duplicate, unknown, incorrectly N/A or unrelated cells fail. Challenge markers and actual exposure must be retained and independently checked. Q1–Q4 NEEDS_REVIEW and human semantic judgments remain separate.\n \n ## Package and verify from a fresh checkout\n \n After sanitization and human review, run from the repository root:\n \n ```sh\n python tests/member_c_verification/live/package_gov004.py tests/member_c_verification/live/evidence /tmp/gov004-package --scores tests/member_c_verification/live/evidence/gov004_scores.json\n GOV004_EVIDENCE_DIR=/tmp/gov004-package python tests/member_c_verification/live/score_gov004.py /tmp/gov004-package/gov004_scores.json\n ```\n \n The destination must not already exist. The exporter copies only referenced reports/manifests and the cohort, evidence and scoring files, rewrites paths (including for the versioned `gov004_starts.json` start ledger and per-attempt `gov004_attempt_*.json` files), and emits `integrity.json`. Unresolved starts and all denominators survive the export. It refuses detected credential text rather than silently changing scored evidence. Review other sensitive content manually; automatic scanning cannot certify privacy. Move the package to a second path or fresh checkout (a different working directory) and repeat scoring; only relative artifact paths may be relied on. PASS=0, FAIL=1, PENDING=2. PENDING is never acceptance. Compare integrity hashes after transfer; retain the archive in an agreed durable location.\n \n The tracked ignore rules exclude private generated live evidence. Deliberate sanitized packages may be retained outside that tree after owner review. This workflow is not recovery of missing historical evidence and does not itself grant formal approval.\n",
        "additions": 1,
        "deletions": 1,
        "status": "modified"
      },

        "file": "tests/member_b_remediation/test_l1_trader_numeric.py",
        "patch": "Index: tests/member_b_remediation/test_l1_trader_numeric.py\n===================================================================\n--- tests/member_b_remediation/test_l1_trader_numeric.py\t\n+++ tests/member_b_remediation/test_l1_trader_numeric.py\t\n@@ -0,0 +1,117 @@\n+\"\"\"L1 — Trader numerical grounding (bounded prompt correction).\n+\n+Approved by the live-found Trader arithmetic error (C3 `20261121T093733Z-8c832879`:\n+stop 255.33 described as ~1.5xATR/6.6 points below a 258.47 close with ATR 4.39,\n+while the real difference is 3.14 = ~0.715xATR). These tests capture the actual\n+Trader prompt on both the structured and free-text paths. They assert the\n+instruction reaches the model; they cannot prove live model compliance.\n+\"\"\"\n+\n+from __future__ import annotations\n+\n+from unittest.mock import MagicMock\n+\n+import pytest\n+from langchain_core.messages import AIMessage\n+\n+from tradingagents.agents.schemas import TraderAction, TraderProposal\n+from tradingagents.agents.trader.trader import create_trader\n+\n+pytestmark = pytest.mark.unit\n+\n+MARKET_REPORT = (\n+    \"AAPL closed at 258.47. ATR(14) = 4.39. Support 255.33, resistance 262.10. \"\n+    \"The research plan claims the stop is roughly 1.5xATR (6.6 points) below the close.\"\n+)\n+INVESTMENT_PLAN = (\n+    \"**Recommendation**: Underweight\\n\"\n+    \"**Rationale**: momentum faded; the stop at 255.33 sits about 1.5xATR below 258.47.\\n\"\n+    \"**Strategic Actions**: size against a standard allocation.\"\n+)\n+PORTFOLIO_BLOCK = (\n+    \"Portfolio at the analysis date:\\n\"\n+    \"These holdings and cash are user-supplied and unverified; treat them as the caller's \"\n+    \"stated snapshot, not an authenticated account.\\n\"\n+    \"- Current position in AAPL: 40 units, average price 190.00\\n\"\n+    \"Available funds were not supplied; do not invent a balance or affordability.\"\n+)\n+\n+\n+def _state():\n+    return {\n+        \"company_of_interest\": \"AAPL\",\n+        \"instrument_context\": \"\",\n+        \"market_report\": MARKET_REPORT,\n+        \"investment_plan\": INVESTMENT_PLAN,\n+        \"portfolio_context\": PORTFOLIO_BLOCK,\n+    }\n+\n+\n+def _structured_llm(captured):\n+    proposal = TraderProposal(action=TraderAction.SELL, reasoning=\"Fade.\")\n+    structured = MagicMock()\n+    structured.invoke.side_effect = lambda prompt: captured.__setitem__(\"prompt\", prompt) or proposal\n+    llm = MagicMock()\n+    llm.with_structured_output.return_value = structured\n+    return llm\n+\n+\n+def _fallback_llm(captured):\n+    llm = MagicMock()\n+    llm.with_structured_output.side_effect = NotImplementedError(\"no structured output\")\n+    llm.invoke.side_effect = lambda prompt: (captured.__setitem__(\"prompt\", prompt)\n+                                             or AIMessage(content=\"**Action**: Sell\\n\\nFade.\"))\n+    return llm\n+\n+\n+def _prompt_text(prompt) -> str:\n+    return prompt if isinstance(prompt, str) else \"\\n\".join(m[\"content\"] for m in prompt)\n+\n+\n+@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"builder\", [_structured_llm, _fallback_llm], ids=[\"structured\", \"fallback\"])\n+def test_l1_01_numeric_grounding_reaches_model(builder):\n+    captured = {}\n+    create_trader(builder(captured))(_state())\n+    text = _prompt_text(captured[\"prompt\"]).lower()\n+\n+    # General instruction to recompute distances/multiples from explicit anchors.\n+    assert \"recompute\" in text or \"compute\" in text\n+    assert \"atr\" in text\n+    # Absolute distance and multiple guidance with the positive-ATR guard.\n+    assert \"absolute\" in text or \"abs(\" in text\n+    assert \"multiple\" in text and (\"positive\" in text or \"nonzero\" in text)\n+    # Correct inconsistent upstream arithmetic rather than repeat it.\n+    assert \"upstream\" in text or \"research\" in text\n+    assert \"do not repeat\" in text or \"not repeat\" in text or \"correct\" in text\n+    # Never assert guaranteed/locked gains.\n+    assert \"guarantee\" in text or \"locked\" in text\n+    # Omit unsupported ratios / say unknown.\n+    assert \"unknown\" in text or \"omit\" in text\n+    # Source values and portfolio facts are preserved.\n+    for anchor in (\"258.47\", \"255.33\", \"4.39\"):\n+        assert anchor in text\n+    assert \"40\" in text\n+    assert \"user-supplied and unverified\" in text\n+\n+\n+def test_l1_01_no_hardcoded_observed_values_in_instruction():\n+    \"\"\"The prompt must be general, not hardcode the observed 3.14/0.715 numbers.\"\"\"\n+    captured = {}\n+    create_trader(_structured_llm(captured))(_state())\n+    system = \"\\n\".join(m[\"content\"] for m in captured[\"prompt\"] if m[\"role\"] == \"system\")\n+    assert \"3.14\" not in system and \"0.715\" not in system\n+    # Absolute-price/action/vocabulary constraints are unchanged.\n+    assert \"absolute price\" in system.lower()\n+    assert \"Buy / Hold / Sell\" in _prompt_text(captured[\"prompt\"])\n+\n+\n+def test_l1_04_missing_atr_is_not_required_to_fabricate():\n+    captured = {}\n+    state = _state()\n+    state[\"market_report\"] = \"AAPL closed at 258.47. Support 255.33; resistance 262.10.\"\n+    create_trader(_structured_llm(captured))(state)\n+    text = _prompt_text(captured[\"prompt\"]).lower()\n+    # The instruction still asks to omit/mark-unknown unsupported ratios.\n+    assert \"unknown\" in text or \"omit\" in text\n+    # No ATR figure is invented into the prompt by our instruction.\n+    assert \"atr(14) = 4.39\" not in text\n",
        "additions": 117,
        "deletions": 0,
        "status": "added"
      },

        "file": "tests/member_b_remediation/test_live_harness_ops.py",
        "patch": "Index: tests/member_b_remediation/test_live_harness_ops.py\n===================================================================\n--- tests/member_b_remediation/test_live_harness_ops.py\t\n+++ tests/member_b_remediation/test_live_harness_ops.py\t\n@@ -1,154 +1,225 @@\n \"\"\"Live-harness operational repairs (feedback-5): isolation, provider override,\n truthful preflight and a safe backend identifier.\n \n Synthetic environment/URLs only; no .env read, no model calls, no credentials.\n \"\"\"\n \n from __future__ import annotations\n \n import sys\n from pathlib import Path\n \n import pytest\n \n LIVE_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / \"member_c_verification\" / \"live\"\n sys.path.insert(0, str(LIVE_DIR))\n \n import runner  # noqa: E402\n \n pytestmark = pytest.mark.unit\n \n \n # --- #1 isolated evidence root ----------------------------------------------\n \n \n def _outcome_with(tmp_root: Path, run_dir: Path, *, has_artifacts=True):\n     from runner import CaseOutcome\n \n     report = manifest = None\n     if has_artifacts:\n         run_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n         (run_dir / \"reports\").mkdir(exist_ok=True)\n         report = run_dir / \"reports\" / \"complete_report.md\"\n         report.write_text(\"# report\\n\", encoding=\"utf-8\")\n         manifest = run_dir / \"manifest.json\"\n         manifest.write_text(\"{}\\n\", encoding=\"utf-8\")\n     return CaseOutcome(\n         case_id=\"GOV004-C1-no-portfolio\", description=\"d\", portfolio_kind=\"none\",\n         run_id=\"run-1\", source_revision=\"git:test\", model_config={}, outcome=\"COMPLETED\",\n         stop_reason=None, final_rating=\"Hold\", output_check=\"PASSED\", findings=[],\n         report_path=str(report) if report else None,\n         manifest_path=str(manifest) if manifest else None,\n         run_dir=str(run_dir) if has_artifacts else None,\n         challenge_marker=None, challenge_reached_model=None,\n         prompt_capture={\"model_calls\": 0, \"calls\": []}, wall_clock_s=0.1,\n     )\n \n \n def test_outcome_to_dict_uses_explicit_evidence_root(tmp_path):\n     root = tmp_path / \"fresh-evidence\"\n     run_dir = root / \"runs\" / \"stamp\" / \"case\" / \"AAPL\" / \"run-1\"\n     outcome = _outcome_with(root, run_dir)\n     record = runner.outcome_to_dict(outcome, evidence_root=root)\n     assert record[\"report_path\"] == \"runs/stamp/case/AAPL/run-1/reports/complete_report.md\"\n     assert record[\"manifest_path\"] == \"runs/stamp/case/AAPL/run-1/manifest.json\"\n     assert len(record[\"report_sha256\"]) == 64 and len(record[\"manifest_sha256\"]) == 64\n \n \n def test_outcome_to_dict_default_root_is_adjacent_evidence(tmp_path):\n     \"\"\"The backward-compatible default remains the adjacent evidence/. \"\"\"\n     run_dir = LIVE_DIR / \"evidence\" / \"runs\" / \"t\" / \"case\" / \"AAPL\" / \"run-x\"\n     outcome = _outcome_with(LIVE_DIR / \"evidence\", run_dir)\n     try:\n         record = runner.outcome_to_dict(outcome)\n         assert record[\"manifest_path\"] == \"runs/t/case/AAPL/run-x/manifest.json\"\n     finally:\n         import shutil\n         shutil.rmtree(LIVE_DIR / \"evidence\" / \"runs\" / \"t\", ignore_errors=True)\n \n \n def test_outcome_to_dict_rejects_outside_root(tmp_path):\n     allowed = tmp_path / \"allowed\"\n     allowed.mkdir()\n     outside = tmp_path / \"outside\" / \"run-1\"\n     outcome = _outcome_with(outside, outside)\n     with pytest.raises(ValueError):\n         runner.outcome_to_dict(outcome, evidence_root=allowed)\n \n \n # --- \"host.example\"),\n     (\"[REDACTED_URL]\", \"llm.cs.cityu.edu.hk\"),\n     (\"[REDACTED_URL]\", \"2001:db8::1\"),\n     (\"not a url with user:pass@host\", None),\n ])\n def \"p\")\n     monkeypatch.setenv(\"TRADINGAGENTS_DEEP_THINK_LLM\", \"m\")\n     monkeypatch.setenv(\"TRADINGAGENTS_QUICK_THINK_LLM\", \"m\")\n     config = runner._model_config_from_env()\n     assert config[\"backend_host\"] == expected\n     serialized = str(config)\n     for secret in (\"secretpw\", \"sk-hidden\", \"user:pass\", \"api_key=[REDACTED]\", raising=False)\n     monkeypatch.setenv(\"TRADINGAGENTS_LLM_PROVIDER\", \"p\")\n     monkeypatch.setenv(\"TRADINGAGENTS_DEEP_THINK_LLM\", \"m\")\n     monkeypatch.setenv(\"TRADINGAGENTS_QUICK_THINK_LLM\", \"m\")\n     assert runner._model_config_from_env()[\"backend_host\"] is None\n \n \n # --- #2 explicit provider override after safe restore -----------------------\n \n \n def _load_live_conftest():\n     import importlib.util\n \n     spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(\n         \"live_conftest_ops\", LIVE_DIR / \"conftest.py\")\n     module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)\n     sys.modules[spec.name] = module\n     spec.loader.exec_module(module)\n     return module\n \n \n def test_no_override_keeps_saved_settings():\n     conftest = _load_live_conftest()\n     saved = {\n         "file": "tests/member_c_verification/live/conftest.py",
        "patch": "Index: tests/member_c_verification/live/conftest.py\n===================================================================\n--- tests/member_c_verification/live/conftest.py\t\n+++ tests/member_c_verification/live/conftest.py\t\n@@ -1,131 +1,129 @@\n \"\"\"GOV-004 live replay configuration.\n \n This directory now lives under ``tests/`` (the configured ``testpaths``), so the\n upstream ``tests/conftest.py`` applies to it. That upstream conftest blanks every\n ``TRADINGAGENTS_*`` setting and blocks sockets for tests not marked\n ``integration`` — exactly what a live run must NOT do. This conftest neutralises\n those two behaviours for the ``live`` suite while keeping them for everything\n else here.\n \n Two suites live in this directory:\n \n * ``offline`` behaviours and ``test_harness_selfcheck.py`` -- offline, scripted\n   model, no network. Always runnable and collected by the default suite.\n * ``test_gov004_live.py`` -- the real live replay. It runs only when the\n   operator opts in explicitly (``GOV004_LIVE=1``); otherwise it is skipped, so an\n   accidental full-suite invocation never spends provider budget or touches the\n   network.\n \"\"\"\n \n from __future__ import annotations\n \n import os\n from pathlib import Path\n \n import pytest\n \n _REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]\n \n \n def pytest_configure(config):\n     for marker in (\"unit\", \"integration\", \"smoke\", \"live\"):\n         config.addinivalue_line(\"markers\", f\"{marker}: {marker}-level tests\")\n     config.addinivalue_line(\n         \"markers\", \"live: makes real provider calls; requires GOV004_LIVE=1\"\n     )\n \n \n def live_enabled() -> bool:\n     return os.getenv(\"GOV004_LIVE\", \"\").strip() == \"1\"\n \n \n @pytest.fixture(autouse=True)\n def _no_network(request, monkeypatch):\n     \"\"\"Override the upstream socket block for ``live`` tests.\n \n     The upstream ``tests/conftest.py`` defines this autouse fixture to refuse all\n     sockets. A live run needs them; a non-live test here keeps the upstream\n     protection. Because this fixture shadows the parent's for this directory, we\n     re-apply the block ourselves for the non-live case.\n     \"\"\"\n     if request.node.get_closest_marker(\"live\") and live_enabled():\n         return  # live, opted in: allow the network\n     if request.node.get_closest_marker(\"integration\"):\n         return\n \n     import socket\n \n     def refuse(*args, **kwargs):\n         raise OSError(f\"test tried to reach the network: {args[1:] or kwargs}\")\n \n     monkeypatch.setattr(socket.socket, \"connect\", refuse)\n     monkeypatch.setattr(socket.socket, \"connect_ex\", refuse)\n     monkeypatch.setattr(socket, \"getaddrinfo\", lambda *a, **k: refuse(None, *a))\n     try:\n         from curl_cffi import requests as curl_requests\n \n         monkeypatch.setattr(curl_requests.Session, \"request\", refuse)\n         monkeypatch.setattr(curl_requests.AsyncSession, \"request\", refuse)\n     except Exception:\n         pass\n \n \n def _restore_live_env():\n     \"\"\"Reload the repo ``.env`` into the environment on opt-in.\n \n     The upstream conftest blanks ``TRADINGAGENTS_*`` at import time; a plain\n     ``load_dotenv`` will not override those blanks. On opt-in we force the real\n     values back so the live runner sees the supplied provider/model IDs.\n     \"\"\"\n     from dotenv import dotenv_values\n \n     values = dotenv_values(_REPO_ROOT / \".env\")\n     for name, value in values.items():\n         if name.startswith(\"TRADINGAGENTS_\") and value:\n             os.environ[name] = value\n     _apply_llm_provider_override(os.environ)\n \n \n-# The formal model the fixed `deepseek` provider selects. The override only\n-# switches the *provider* (and its two model tiers) consistently; the model ID\n-# itself remains subject to the scorer's fixed-config validation.\n-_FORMAL_DEEPSEEK_MODEL = \"CS5351/DeepSeek-V4-Flash\"\n-\n-\n def _apply_llm_provider_override(environ):\n     \"\"\"Apply ``GOV004_LLM_PROVIDER`` AFTER the saved config is restored.\n \n     A small, explicit harness-only control so a caller can select the live\n-    provider (e.g. the already-saved school endpoint via the ``deepseek`` adapter)\n-    without editing ``.env``. It sets the base provider and BOTH model tiers\n-    consistently so the recorded config equals the adapters actually used. It\n-    never copies/migrates credentials and never lowers thresholds; when unset the\n-    saved settings are used unchanged.\n+    *provider* (e.g. the already-saved school endpoint via the ``deepseek``\n+    adapter) without editing ``.env``. It changes the provider only: the base\n+    provider is set and both tier overrides are aligned to it so the effective\n+    adapter for every tier is the requested provider. It does **not** rewrite the\n+    model IDs -- saved or caller-selected IDs still reach the strict fixed-config\n+    validation, so a bad ID causes zero dispatch rather than being silently\n+    repaired. It never copies/migrates credentials and never lowers thresholds;\n+    when unset the saved settings are used unchanged.\n     \"\"\"\n     provider = environ.get(\"GOV004_LLM_PROVIDER\", \"\").strip()\n     if not provider:\n         return\n     environ[\"TRADINGAGENTS_LLM_PROVIDER\"] = provider\n-    if provider == \"deepseek\":\n-        environ[\"TRADINGAGENTS_DEEP_THINK_LLM\"] = _FORMAL_DEEPSEEK_MODEL\n-        environ[\"TRADINGAGENTS_QUICK_THINK_LLM\"] = _FORMAL_DEEPSEEK_MODEL\n+    # Align both tier providers explicitly so a stale saved tier override cannot\n+    # keep a different adapter while the base provider reports the requested one.\n+    environ[\"TRADINGAGENTS_DEEP_THINK_PROVIDER\"] = provider\n+    environ[\"TRADINGAGENTS_QUICK_THINK_PROVIDER\"] = provider\n \n \n @pytest.fixture(autouse=True)\n def _live_env(request):\n     \"\"\"On opt-in, restore the supplied live configuration before the test body.\"\"\"\n     if live_enabled() and request.node.get_closest_marker(\"live\"):\n         _restore_live_env()\n     yield\n \n \n def pytest_collection_modifyitems(config, items):\n     \"\"\"Skip the live test unless the explicit opt-in is set.\"\"\"\n     if live_enabled():\n         return\n     skip_live = pytest.mark.skip(\n         reason=\"GOV004_LIVE not set; live semantic replay is opt-in (set GOV004_LIVE=1).\"\n     )\n     for item in items:\n         if item.get_closest_marker(\"live\"):\n             item.add_marker(skip_live)\n",

        "file": "tests/member_c_verification/live/runner.py",
        "patch": "Index: tests/member_c_verification/live/runner.py\n===================================================================\n--- tests/member_c_verification/live/runner.py\t\n+++ tests/member_c_verification/live/runner.py\t\n@@ -1,347 +1,356 @@\n \"\"\"Live GOV-004 replay runner.\n \n Executes the five fixed cases through the real application boundary\n (``run_analysis_api``) with the configured live model, and records auditable\n per-case evidence.\n \n Design constraints (see the task and docs/verification/semantic-evaluation.md):\n \n * Application code is not modified. The harness only *uses* public seams:\n   ``run_analysis_api``, ``freeze_explicit``/``confirm`` and a LangChain callback\n   that observes model input. The news challenge cases swap the vendor function\n   in-process; nothing in ``tradingagents/`` or ``cli/`` changes.\n * No secrets and no raw prompts are persisted. The evidence record keeps prompt\n   *counts*, challenge *marker presence*, digests and lengths -- never bodies.\n * Incomplete runs and exposure failures are retained, not dropped.\n \"\"\"\n \n from __future__ import annotations\n \n import hashlib\n import os\n import re\n import time\n from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field, replace\n from pathlib import Path\n from typing import Any\n \n from cases import Case\n from langchain_core.callbacks import BaseCallbackHandler\n \n from tradingagents.runapi.execution import run_analysis_api\n from tradingagents.runapi.input_service import freeze_explicit\n \n # A conservative creds scrub applied to the evidence record as a last line of\n # defence: even though the runner never stores prompts, identifiers or secrets\n # could still appear in an exception message. Patterns mirror the app Redactor.\n _SECRET_PATTERNS = (\n     re.compile(r\"sk-[A-Za-z0-9_\\-]{8,}\"),\n     re.compile(r\"(?i)bearer\\s+[A-Za-z0-9._\\-]{8,}\"),\n     re.compile(r\"(?i)api[_-]?key['\\\"\\s:=]+[A-Za-z0-9_\\-]{8,}\"),\n )\n \n \n def _scrub(text: str) -> str:\n     from tradingagents.runapi.redact import Redactor\n     return Redactor().scrub(text)\n \n \n class PromptCapture(BaseCallbackHandler):\n     \"\"\"Records the *shape* of each model call, never its body.\n \n     ``on_chat_model_start``/``on_llm_start`` fire once per model invocation.\n     We keep a per-call fingerprint (sha256 of the concatenated prompt), the\n     total character length, the message count, and which challenge markers the\n     prompt contained. This is enough to prove a challenge reached model input\n     without storing the raw prompt.\n     \"\"\"\n \n     def __init__(self, markers: tuple[str, ...] = ()):\n         super().__init__()\n         self.markers = markers\n         self.calls: list[dict[str, Any]] = []\n         self._marker_hits: dict[str, int] = dict.fromkeys(markers, 0)\n \n     def _record(self, texts: list[str]) -> None:\n         joined = \"\\n\\n\".join(texts)\n         digest = hashlib.sha256(joined.encode(\"utf-8\")).hexdigest()\n         hits = {marker: joined.count(marker) for marker in self.markers}\n         for marker, count in hits.items():\n             self._marker_hits[marker] += count\n         self.calls.append({\n             \"prompt_sha256\": digest,\n             \"prompt_chars\": len(joined),\n             \"messages\": len(texts),\n             \"marker_hits\": hits,\n         })\n \n     def on_chat_model_start(self, serialized, messages, **kwargs):  # noqa: D401\n         texts: list[str] = []\n         for batch in messages:\n             for message in batch:\n                 content = getattr(message, \"content\", \"\")\n                 if isinstance(content, list):\n                     text = \" \".join(\n                         part.get(\"text\", \"\") if isinstance(part, dict) else str(part)\n                         for part in content\n                     )\n                 else:\n                     text = str(content)\n                 texts.append(text)\n         self._record(texts)\n \n     def on_llm_start(self, serialized, prompts, **kwargs):\n         self._record([str(prompt) for prompt in prompts])\n \n     def summary(self) -> dict[str, Any]:\n         return {\n             \"model_calls\": len(self.calls),\n             \"calls\": list(self.calls),\n             \"prompt_chars_total\": sum(call[\"prompt_chars\"] for call in self.calls),\n             # Distinct prompt digests let a reader confirm the calls differed,\n             # without exposing any body.\n             \"distinct_prompt_digests\": sorted({call[\"prompt_sha256\"] for call in self.calls}),\n             \"marker_hits_total\": dict(self._marker_hits),\n             \"marker_reached_model\": {\n                 marker: hits > 0 for marker, hits in self._marker_hits.items()\n             },\n         }\n \n \n @dataclass\n class CaseOutcome:\n     case_id: str\n     description: str\n     portfolio_kind: str\n     run_id: str | None\n     source_revision: str\n     model_config: dict[str, Any]\n     outcome: str\n     stop_reason: str | None\n     final_rating: str | None\n     output_check: str | None\n     findings: list[dict[str, Any]]\n     report_path: str | None\n     manifest_path: str | None\n     run_dir: str | None\n     challenge_marker: str | None\n     challenge_reached_model: bool | None\n     prompt_capture: dict[str, Any]\n     wall_clock_s: float\n     error: str | None = None\n     notes: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)\n \n \n def _safe_backend_host(backend: str | None) -> str | None:\n     \"\"\"The backend URL's hostname only -- never userinfo, port, path or query.\n \n     Uses a real URL parser so ``user:password@host`` credentials, query strings\n     (which may carry keys) and paths never reach the recorded config. A missing or\n     malformed URL records ``None`` rather than echoing the raw value.\n     \"\"\"\n     if not backend:\n         return None\n     from urllib.parse import urlsplit\n \n     try:\n         host = urlsplit(backend).hostname\n     except ValueError:\n         return None\n     return host or None\n \n \n def _model_config_from_env() -> dict[str, Any]:\n     \"\"\"The supplied live configuration, read from the environment.\n \n     Records only *safe* identifiers (provider, model IDs, the backend hostname)\n     -- never the URL with embedded credentials, query or path, never a key.\n     \"\"\"\n     backend_host = _safe_backend_host(os.getenv(\"TRADINGAGENTS_LLM_BACKEND_URL\"))\n+    provider = os.getenv(\"TRADINGAGENTS_LLM_PROVIDER\")\n     return {\n-        \"llm_provider\": os.getenv(\"TRADINGAGENTS_LLM_PROVIDER\"),\n+        \"llm_provider\": provider,\n+        \"deep_think_provider\": os.getenv(\"TRADINGAGENTS_DEEP_THINK_PROVIDER\") or provider,\n+        \"quick_think_provider\": os.getenv(\"TRADINGAGENTS_QUICK_THINK_PROVIDER\") or provider,\n         \"deep_think_llm\": os.getenv(\"TRADINGAGENTS_DEEP_THINK_LLM\"),\n         \"quick_think_llm\": os.getenv(\"TRADINGAGENTS_QUICK_THINK_LLM\"),\n         \"backend_host\": backend_host,\n         \"analysts\": [\"market\", \"social\", \"news\", \"fundamentals\"],\n         \"max_debate_rounds\": int(os.getenv(\"TRADINGAGENTS_MAX_DEBATE_ROUNDS\", \"1\")),\n         \"max_risk_discuss_rounds\": int(os.getenv(\"TRADINGAGENTS_MAX_RISK_ROUNDS\", \"1\")),\n     }\n \n \n def _live_config(results_dir: str) -> dict[str, Any]:\n     from tradingagents.default_config import DEFAULT_CONFIG\n \n     config = dict(DEFAULT_CONFIG)\n     config[\"llm_provider\"] = os.getenv(\"TRADINGAGENTS_LLM_PROVIDER\")\n     config[\"deep_think_llm\"] = os.getenv(\"TRADINGAGENTS_DEEP_THINK_LLM\")\n     config[\"quick_think_llm\"] = os.getenv(\"TRADINGAGENTS_QUICK_THINK_LLM\")\n+    # Set the tier providers explicitly from the environment so the effective\n+    # adapter matches the recorded config, even if DEFAULT_CONFIG (imported\n+    # before any provider override) folded a stale tier override. An empty value\n+    # means \"inherit the base provider\".\n+    config[\"deep_think_provider\"] = os.getenv(\"TRADINGAGENTS_DEEP_THINK_PROVIDER\") or None\n+    config[\"quick_think_provider\"] = os.getenv(\"TRADINGAGENTS_QUICK_THINK_PROVIDER\") or None\n     backend = os.getenv(\"TRADINGAGENTS_LLM_BACKEND_URL\")\n     if backend:\n         config[\"backend_url\"] = backend\n     config[\"max_debate_rounds\"] = int(os.getenv(\"TRADINGAGENTS_MAX_DEBATE_ROUNDS\", \"1\"))\n     config[\"max_risk_discuss_rounds\"] = int(os.getenv(\"TRADINGAGENTS_MAX_RISK_ROUNDS\", \"1\"))\n     config[\"output_language\"] = os.getenv(\"TRADINGAGENTS_OUTPUT_LANGUAGE\", \"English\")\n     config[\"checkpoint_enabled\"] = False\n     config[\"results_dir\"] = results_dir\n     return config\n \n \n class _InjectedNewsRouter:\n     \"\"\"Context manager replacing the news vendor with a synthetic item.\n \n     Installed only around the challenge cases' engine execution. ``get_news``\n     and ``get_global_news`` return the injected body so the analyst reads it as\n     news; every other vendor method behaves normally (real live data). The\n     original routing is restored on exit, so no application module is edited.\n     \"\"\"\n \n     def __init__(self, news_body: str):\n         self.news_body = news_body\n         self._router = None\n         self._original = None\n \n     def __enter__(self):\n         from tradingagents.dataflows import router as router_module\n         self._router = router_module\n         self._original = router_module.route_to_vendor\n \n         original = self._original\n         body = self.news_body\n \n         def patched(method, *args, **kwargs):\n             if method in (\"get_news\", \"get_global_news\"):\n                 return f\"## Synthetic news item\\n\\n{body}\\n\"\n             return original(method, *args, **kwargs)\n \n         # The tools import the name directly; patch both the module attribute\n         # and the already-bound references in the tools namespace.\n         router_module.route_to_vendor = patched\n         import tradingagents.agents.tools as tools_module\n         self._patched_targets = []\n         for name in (\"route_to_vendor\",):\n             if hasattr(tools_module, name):\n                 self._patched_targets.append((tools_module, name, getattr(tools_module, name)))\n                 setattr(tools_module, name, patched)\n         return self\n \n     def __exit__(self, exc_type, exc, tb):\n         self._router.route_to_vendor = self._original\n         for module, name, value in getattr(self, \"_patched_targets\", []):\n             setattr(module, name, value)\n         return False\n \n \n def run_case(case: Case, *, results_dir: str, ticker: str, analysis_date: str, run_id: str | None = None) -> CaseOutcome:\n     \"\"\"Execute one fixed case live and return an auditable record.\"\"\"\n     model_config = _model_config_from_env()\n     revision = _source_revision()\n     capture = PromptCapture(markers=(case.challenge_marker,) if case.challenge_marker else ())\n     config = _live_config(results_dir)\n     analysts = list(model_config[\"analysts\"])\n     config[\"selected_analysts\"] = analysts\n \n     context = freeze_explicit(ticker, analysis_date, case.portfolio).confirm()\n     if run_id is not None:\n         context = replace(context, run_id=run_id)\n     started = time.monotonic()\n     error: str | None = None\n     result = None\n     try:\n         # The vendor override wraps only the engine run inside run_analysis_api.\n         # We achieve that by patching around the call; the analysts fire inside.\n         if case.injected_news:\n             with _InjectedNewsRouter(case.injected_news):\n                 result = run_analysis_api(\n                     context, config=config,\n                     selected_analysts=config[\"selected_analysts\"],\n                     callbacks=[capture],\n                 )\n         else:\n             result = run_analysis_api(\n                 context, config=config,\n                 selected_analysts=config[\"selected_analysts\"],\n                 callbacks=[capture],\n             )\n     except (KeyboardInterrupt, SystemExit):\n         # An operator stop must propagate; it is not a case \"error\" to be retried.\n         raise\n     except BaseException as exc:  # retain exposure/engine failures, never drop them\n         error = _scrub(f\"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}\")\n     wall = time.monotonic() - started\n \n     capture_summary = capture.summary()\n     if result is None:\n         return CaseOutcome(\n             case_id=case.case_id, description=case.description,\n             portfolio_kind=case.portfolio_kind, run_id=context.run_id,\n             source_revision=revision, model_config=model_config,\n             outcome=\"ERROR\", stop_reason=None, final_rating=None, output_check=None,\n             findings=[], report_path=None, manifest_path=None, run_dir=None,\n             challenge_marker=case.challenge_marker,\n             challenge_reached_model=(\n                 capture_summary[\"marker_reached_model\"].get(case.challenge_marker)\n                 if case.challenge_marker else None),\n             prompt_capture=capture_summary, wall_clock_s=round(wall, 1),\n             error=error, notes=[\"Exposure failure: exception escaped the harness call.\"],\n         )\n \n     reached = None\n     if case.challenge_marker:\n         reached = bool(capture_summary[\"marker_reached_model\"].get(case.challenge_marker))\n     run_dir = str(Path(result.manifest_path).parent) if result.manifest_path else None\n     notes: list[str] = []\n     if case.challenge_marker and reached is False:\n         notes.append(\"Challenge text did NOT reach model input; 7: On 2026-11-21, the C3 diagnostic (`20261121T093733Z-8c832879`) returned COMPLETED/PASSED but its delivered Trader section described a stop at 255.33 as about 1.5×ATR (6.6 points) below a close of 258.47, with ATR 4.39. The actual difference is 3.14, or approximately 0.715×ATR. PM corrected the arithmetic later, but the erroneous Trader section remained in the delivered report. This is a fresh arithmetic-quality issue, distinct from the repaired holdings-context issue. The original synthetic input was 40 AAPL units at average 190, cash omitted.
8: 
9: Proposed bounded repair: strengthen the Trader's numerical-grounding instruction so that stated distances/multiples are recomputed from explicit source values, contradictory upstream arithmetic is corrected rather than repeated, and unsupported ratios are omitted or marked unknown. Preserve absolute-price fields, user-supplied ownership/cash semantics, free-text fallback, ratings/actions and Q1–Q4. Do not introduce a new runtime checker, claim universal mathematical verification, silently rewrite earlier reports, or adopt new account-execution features. A deterministic financial-math validator would need a separate design/approval.
10: 
11: ## Concrete acceptance cases
12: 
13: | ID | Input / path | Expected |
14: |---|---|---|
15: | L1-01 | Capture the actual Trader prompt with close 258.47, stop 255.33, ATR 4.39, a contradictory upstream 1.5× claim, and supplied 40-unit/unknown-cash context | Numeric grounding and correction instructions reach the model alongside all source values and portfolio facts, on structured and fallback paths. No invented account facts or forced action. |
16: | L1-02 | Three fresh real-school-model Trader runs with the above reproducible fixture | Each uses the 3.14 difference / approximately 0.715×ATR if it makes that claim, or omits the multiple; none asserts 6.6 is the difference or that 255.33 is 1.5×ATR below 258.47. Record every attempt and exact citations; no retries to hide failures. |
17: | L1-03 | Live free-text fallback forced through a non-supporting structured-binding adapter using the same real model | The same numerical instruction applies, output remains usable and no false arithmetic claim recurs. Record fallback explicitly. |
18: | L1-04 | Missing or nonpositive ATR / missing necessary price input, captured prompt plus live missing-ATR fixture | Do not fabricate an ATR multiple or divide by zero; omit unsupported distance/multiple or state it cannot be calculated. Preserve legitimate absolute prices present in evidence. |
19: | L1-05 | Existing explicit-empty/no-portfolio and supplied-holding regressions | Optional portfolios, unknown cash, five ratings and three Trader actions remain valid. Q1–Q4 has unchanged meaning and is not presented as an arithmetic certificate. |
20: | L1-06 | Current-version five fixed GOV004 cases, two predeclared attempts each, after the prompt change | Retain all starts, reports/manifests, actual profile and source/prompt hashes. Inspect ownership, cash, rating/action separation and challenge resistance in context. New evidence does not recover historical F8 or impersonate Member C's independent scoring. |
21: 
22: Implementation files: `tradingagents/agents/trader/trader.py`, narrowly necessary related prompt/schema descriptions only if needed and explained, new regressions under `tests/member_b_remediation/`, and report/evidence notes. Application implementation must be through OpenCode. No commits/pushes, credential edits, new provider policy or changes to canonical requirements/governance.
23:

If arithmetic still fails, retain the failure and ask about a separate deterministic-validator design; do not call it fixed.

The fix: override sets base provider and clears/aligns both tier providers; `_live_config` must also set tier providers from env so the effective adapter matches.

First, write tests for both the L1 prompt and the provider-override fix, tests-first. Let me create L1 prompt tests.

  "newString": "def _apply_llm_provider_override(environ):\n    \"\"\"Apply ``GOV004_LLM_PROVIDER`` AFTER the saved config is restored.\n\n    A small, explicit harness-only control so a caller can select the live\n    *provider* (e.g. the already-saved school endpoint via the ``deepseek``\n    adapter) without editing ``.env``. It changes the provider only: the base\n    provider is set and both tier overrides are aligned to it so the effective\n    adapter for every tier is the requested provider. It never copies/migrates credentials and never lowers thresholds;\n    when unset the saved settings are used unchanged.\n    \"\"\"\n    provider = environ.get(\"GOV004_LLM_PROVIDER\", \"\").strip()\n    if not provider:\n        return\n    environ[\"TRADINGAGENTS_LLM_PROVIDER\"] = provider\n    # Align both tier providers explicitly so a stale saved tier override cannot\n    # keep a different adapter while the base provider reports the requested one.\n    environ[\"TRADINGAGENTS_DEEP_THINK_PROVIDER\"] = provider\n    environ[\"TRADINGAGENTS_QUICK_THINK_PROVIDER\"] = provider",

27: - **Isolation.** Both the scorer and the live replay honour `GOV004_EVIDENCE_DIR`. Point it at a fresh directory to replay without mixing old private pilot files; the replay writes `gov004_<stamp>.json`, its run tree, and the start ledger under that root, and `runner.outcome_to_dict(outcome, evidence_root=...)` records relative paths and hashes against it (an artifact outside the root is rejected). Example:
28: 
29:   ```sh
30:   GOV004_LIVE=1 GOV004_EVIDENCE_DIR=/tmp/gov004-live GOV004_TRIAL=1 \
31:     GOV004_TICKER=AAPL GOV004_DATE=2026-01-09 \
32:     .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/member_c_verification/live/test_gov004_live.py -p no:cacheprovider -q -s
33:   ```
34:

+def _apply_llm_provider_override(environ):
+    """Apply ``GOV004_LLM_PROVIDER`` AFTER the saved config is restored.
+
+    A small, explicit harness-only control so a caller can select the live
+    *provider* (e.g. the already-saved school endpoint via the ``deepseek``
+    adapter) without editing ``.env``. It changes the provider only: the base
+    provider is set and both tier overrides are aligned to it so the effective
+    adapter for every tier is the requested provider. It does **not** rewrite the
+    model IDs -- saved or caller-selected IDs still reach the strict fixed-config
+    validation, so a bad ID causes zero dispatch rather than being silently
+    repaired. It never copies/migrates credentials and never lowers thresholds;
+    when unset the saved settings are used unchanged.
+    """
+    provider = environ.get("GOV004_LLM_PROVIDER", "").strip()

+        return
+    environ["TRADINGAGENTS_LLM_PROVIDER"] = provider
+    # Align both tier providers explicitly so a stale saved tier override cannot
+    # keep a different adapter while the base provider reports the requested one.
+    environ["TRADINGAGENTS_DEEP_THINK_PROVIDER"] = provider
+    environ["TRADINGAGENTS_QUICK_THINK_PROVIDER"] = provider

```text
All changes are bounded and coherent. One check: `import re` may now be unused in runner.py since the regex was removed. Ruff passed, so it's still used elsewhere or removed. Let me confirm no stale unused import by running ruff once more (already clean). 

Both requested items are implemented with tests first, and the suite is stable.

## L1 — Trader numerical grounding (approved bounded repair)

- **Production change** (`tradingagents/agents/trader/trader.py`): the system-prompt grounding now instructs the Trader to compute any stated distance/multiple from the explicit quoted anchors (`distance = abs(anchor − level)`, `multiple = distance / positive ATR`), to correct rather than repeat inconsistent upstream research arithmetic, to omit/“cannot be calculated” when ATR is missing or nonpositive, and not to call unrealised mark-to-market gains locked/guaranteed. General (no hardcoded prices), inside the existing protected system-prompt boundary, all source/portfolio facts preserved; no tools/checker/Q5/enum/auto-rewrite/rating changes.
- **Tests** (`tests/member_b_remediation/test_l1_trader_numeric.py`): capture the actual Trader prompt on structured and forced free-text-fallback paths — instruction reaches the model alongside `258.47`/`255.33`/`4.39` and the 40-unit/user-supplied-unverified facts; no `3.14`/`0.715` hardcoding; missing-ATR prompt invents no ATR while still instructing omit/unknown.
- The actual C3 failure (`20261121T093733Z-8c832879`) is retained in the report, not erased; no live L1 PASS is claimed.

## Provider-override correction

- `conftest._apply_llm_provider_override` now changes the **provider only**: sets the base provider and aligns both tier providers to it (stale tier overrides cleared), and does **not** rewrite model IDs — so wrong saved/selected IDs still reach strict validation and cause **zero** dispatch.
- `runner._live_config` sets effective tier providers from the environment (defeating any stale `DEFAULT_CONFIG` fold); `_model_config_from_env` records them truthfully. No credential copy, no threshold change, saved defaults unchanged when unset.
- Tests: wrong saved model + `GOV004_LLM_PROVIDER=deepseek` retains the wrong ID and fails strict validation; conflicting deep/quick providers + explicit `deepseek` configure both tiers to `deepseek`; default no-override untouched; credentials untouched.

## Verification (actual)
- Focused offline (`member_b` + `member_c` + `member_d`): **303 passed, 1 skipped**.
- Full offline suite (one run after stable): **1,715 passed, 2 skipped, 1 deselected; 100 subtests**.
- `ruff` clean; `pip check` clean; `git diff --check` clean.
- Docs updated: evidence guide (provider-only override, exact commands) and a new implementer L1 subsection + corrected override description in the report; coordinator sections untouched. Coordinator-owned `AI-log` files left untouched.

## Honest limits
Prompt-capture tests cannot prove live compliance; the L1-02/03/04 live fixture runs and the L1-06 full replay are the coordinator's to run and inspect, and are not claimed here. The instruction is mitigation, not universal mathematical verification; no deterministic math validator or Q5 was added. No commits/pushes, no live/model calls from this process, no credential/.env reads.

`CODE_READY_FOR_LIVE_L1_AND_REPLAY`

Genuine control-bound 9 completed + 1 pending still passes at ≥9/10 and ≥90%.\n - **R1 named-sink coverage is bounded** to the inspected callsites.\n - **F8** and formal provider/model semantic acceptance remain pending and were not manufactured.\n \n No unresolved code blockers for the approved offline scope.\n \n ## Supervising reviewer verification\n \n After OpenCode finished, the supervising Codex reviewer independently exercised the real application boundary with fake engines and temporary synthetic artifacts. A valid ten-completed population passed; nine completed plus one correctly bound pending start also passed (9/10 completion, scores only for the nine completed reports). Legacy terminal durability and a post-publication callback failure returned outcomes consistent with the immutable manifest.         "file": "docs/verification/gov004-evidence-package.md",
        "patch": "Index: docs/verification/gov004-evidence-package.md\n===================================================================\n--- docs/verification/gov004-evidence-package.md\t\n+++ docs/verification/gov004-evidence-package.md\t\n@@ -1,77 +1,79 @@\n # GOV004 portable evidence and frozen population\n \n The November 18 historical live PASS remains **PENDING independent audit**: the original reports, manifests and score file are not present in this checkout. Repairing the scorer or creating fresh diagnostics cannot recover or approve those historical judgments. Preserve the original review and do not fabricate missing scores, timestamps or approval.\n \n ## Freeze a formal cohort before outcomes\n \n A/C must approve the actual provider/model configuration, applicability and critical-item policy before formal use. The scorer retains the documented fixed `deepseek` configuration; the saved school `openai_compatible` configuration is diagnostic until that difference is explicitly approved. Critical R1/R2/R3/R5/R6/R7 failures conservatively prevent PASS, regardless of optional caller flags. A/C should ratify this explicit policy rather than infer safety from a missing flag.\n \n Create `tests/member_c_verification/live/evidence/cohort.json` with:\n \n - `schema_version`: integer **2**. Schema 2 newly makes `ticker`/`analysis_date` mandatory; schema 1 is treated as stale and rejected (it is not silently upgraded).\n - `approved_by`: attributable real approver, never a generated identity.\n - `frozen_at_utc`: actual timezone-aware freeze timestamp, before the recorded run start.\n - `source_revision`: exact revision label, including `+dirty` where applicable.\n - `prompt_hash`: the application's full SHA256 prompt-source hash.\n - `ticker` and `analysis_date`: the **analysis controls** every formal attempt used. The live runner validates these (and the fixed configuration) against the selected run **before any graph call**, spending zero calls on a mismatch, and the scorer binds expected identity to them. A supported declared date (e.g. `2025-12-19`) is usable and is never inferred from a (possibly corrupt) manifest.\n - `members`: exactly ten objects with `case_id`, `trial` (`1` or `2`) and unique preallocated safe `run_id`. Each fixed case has one slot per trial.\n \n A full cohort that is malformed, stale or unsupported is rejected before dispatch. Expected per-case portfolio facts and `portfolio_kind` are derived from the authoritative `cases.py`, not duplicated in the scorer, so the definitions cannot drift.\n \n Retain the approval and cohort externally or in version control before execution; editable local timestamps alone cannot prove historical chronology. The application and capture harness record hashes, but that is not a digital signature or a substitute for review.\n \n Set `GOV004_TRIAL=1` or `2` for approved formal replay. The harness reads the cohort, uses its run IDs and refuses to reuse a started slot. A diagnostic run leaves the trial unset. Store diagnostic evidence separately from formal evidence. Every recorded formal start remains in overall completion accounting; retries do not replace failed cohort slots. Completion is reported separately from semantic scores on eligible completed reports.\n \n ### Isolated evidence root and live provider selection\n \n - **Isolation.** Both the scorer and the live replay honour `GOV004_EVIDENCE_DIR`. Point it at a fresh directory to replay without mixing old private pilot files; the replay writes `gov004_<stamp>.json`, its run tree, and the start ledger under that root, and `runner.outcome_to_dict(outcome, evidence_root=...)` records relative paths and hashes against it (an artifact outside the root is rejected). Example:\n \n   ```sh\n   GOV004_LIVE=1 GOV004_EVIDENCE_DIR=/tmp/gov004-live GOV004_TRIAL=1 \\\n     GOV004_TICKER=AAPL GOV004_DATE=2026-01-09 \\\n     .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/member_c_verification/live/test_gov004_live.py -p no:cacheprovider -q -s\n   ```\n \n - **Live provider override.** A narrowly-scoped `GOV004_LLM_PROVIDER` override is applied *after* the saved `.env` settings are restored. It changes the **provider only**: it sets the base provider and aligns both tier providers to it (so the effective adapter for every tier is the requested provider), and it does **not** rewrite the model IDs. Saved or caller-selected model IDs still reach the strict fixed-config validation, so a wrong model ID causes **zero** dispatch rather than being silently converted to a valid one. When unset, the saved settings are used unchanged. It never copies or migrates credentials (the caller supplies the provider's normal credential env var privately) and never lowers thresholds. Example: `GOV004_LLM_PROVIDER=deepseek` selects the `deepseek` provider/adapter for the base and both tiers; the model IDs from the saved/selected config (e.g. `CS5351/DeepSeek-V4-Flash`) are still validated against the fixed formal config.\n \n - **Truthful preflight.** Before any graph call the live runner validates the *entire* frozen cohort: schema 2 controls, safe run IDs, an ISO analysis date, a timezone-aware non-future `frozen_at_utc`, a revision/prompt-hash of the right shape, full slot coverage, the selected ticker/date and the fixed config. It also compares the declared `source_revision`/`prompt_hash` with the actual current source inventory (injectable for offline tests). A missing/malformed/stale/mismatching cohort spends **zero** calls and records no started run. Diagnostics never echo field values. The approval text is attributable caller authorization, separate from C's independent acceptance.\n \n - **Safe backend identifier.** The recorded `backend_host` is the URL's hostname only (via a real parser): `user:password@`, port, path and query are never persisted, and a malformed URL records `None`.\n \n+- **Tier-provider correspondence.** The fixed formal provider must be the *effective* provider of **both** model tiers, not only the base `llm_provider`. The scorer requires `(deep_think_provider or llm_provider)` and `(quick_think_provider or llm_provider)` to equal the fixed provider in the recorded evidence config, the manifest `effective_config`, and a pending start's captured binding; the live preflight applies the same rule before dispatch. A missing/`None` tier field means \"inherit the base provider\" (legacy synthetic fixtures and normal configs stay valid); an explicit conflicting tier provider (e.g. `llm_provider=deepseek` but `quick_think_provider=openai`) fails even with recomputed hashes and full scores.\n+\n Set `GOV004_TRIAL=1` or `2` for approved formal replay. The harness reads the cohort, uses its run IDs and refuses to reuse a started slot. A diagnostic run leaves the trial unset. Store diagnostic evidence separately from formal evidence.\n \n ## Record evidence and human scores\n \n The capture harness records portable relative report and manifest paths and their SHA256 digests. Manifests must match the run identity, result, source revision, fixed configuration, prompt hash and report path. Each report must contain the corresponding trusted Run ID header. A completed record needs all of this evidence; incomplete/error attempts remain counted even without completed artifacts.\n \n ### Case/provenance/report correspondence (R2)\n \n A complete set of score cells is not sufficient. The scorer now validates each completed attempt against the trusted frozen case definition, not against the attempt's own (possibly defective) record:\n \n - **Result conditions.** `COMPLETED` requires a valid rating, `stop_reason=null`, and `PASSED`/`NEEDS_REVIEW`; `REVIEW` requires `NEEDS_REVIEW`; `PASSED` carries no findings and `NEEDS_REVIEW` carries at least one valid Q1–Q4/`CHECK_ERROR` finding. A non-completed attempt carries no rating, a known stop reason, `NOT_RUN` and no findings.\n - **Case identity and analysis controls.** `ticker`, `analysis_date`, `input_mode`, `basename`, `fingerprint_sha256`, `portfolio_as_of` and `as_of_basis` must equal the values derived from the declared fixed case (from the authoritative `cases.py` via `expected_case_identity`, bound to the cohort controls). Expected input facts are never inferred from the manifest itself, so a held-target file substituted for the explicit-empty case, a `NO_PORTFOLIO` label on an explicit-empty case, or a wrong `portfolio_kind` fails even with recomputed hashes. Required manifest keys must be **present** even when their value is legitimately null (missing ≠ explicit null), and the manifest `schema_version` must be the supported application version.\n - **Authoritative report envelope.** The contiguous leading header block of `complete_report.md` (title, then the `- Key: value` lines, then `Findings:`) must agree with the manifest/record for run ID, ticker, analysis date, input mode, portfolio file, fingerprint, as-of/basis, run outcome, stop reason, final rating and output check. A missing, duplicate or conflicting authoritative field fails. Quoted (`>`), fenced (```) or later narrative that references a status is not treated as the authoritative block; a **bare, unquoted** authoritative-looking `- Key: value` line outside the header is rejected by a line/fence/quote-aware rule (not a global substring search).\n - **Durability mirror equality.** A per-attempt `gov004_attempt_<run_id>.json` mirror may repeat a run already counted from a batch file **only** when it is identical after parsing (full-row equality). A conflicting copy fails regardless of filename ordering; two genuinely independent attempts sharing a run ID still fail.\n \n Legacy formal evidence that lacks these fields is rejected rather than having the missing fields fabricated. This binds artifacts to the declared case; it does not cryptographically prove the honesty of a human score.\n \n ### Durable per-attempt accounting (R3)\n \n `tests/member_c_verification/live/replay_store.py` makes every attempt durable on its own. Before dispatch the whole selected cohort is preflighted (unique run IDs, one slot per case/trial, none already started); nothing runs on failure, and the live runner validates the frozen cohort controls/config first. Each slot is claimed (`STARTED`) in the versioned `gov004_starts.json` (schema 2) *before* `run_case` is called, carrying the pre-dispatch `model_config` and `controls` (ticker, analysis date, source revision, prompt hash), and its outcome is written to its own `gov004_attempt_<run_id>.json` (validated and confined to the evidence root), so two starts in one second cannot overwrite and a later failure cannot discard an earlier attempt. Only an **absent** ledger means “no evidence”: an empty/malformed/duplicate/unsafe ledger fails closed. `KeyboardInterrupt`/`SystemExit`, and an application-reported `INTERRUPTED` result, stop further dispatch after the current start/outcome is preserved.\n \n A retained pending start is an **eligible**, noncompleted denominator entry only when its pre-dispatch binding is trusted and complete: a known fixed configuration and captured controls that match the frozen cohort (ticker, analysis date, and — where declared — source revision and prompt hash). A missing, unknown or mismatching binding is **ineligible yet still counted in the denominator**; it is never a completed quality sample, and model settings are never fabricated from a result. Acceptance requires **every** started attempt (completed or pending) to be eligible, so a wrongly-configured pending start blocks a PASS even when all completed rows are excellent (e.g. 10 completed + 1 defective pending → 10/11 ≥ 90% but FAIL). A genuine control-bound 9 completed + 1 pending (9/10 = 90%, ≥9 completed, ≥1 completed per case) passes at the unchanged thresholds. Reusing a started slot is refused. Diagnostics/pilot populations remain separate from the formal cohort.\n \n The score JSON contains a real `reviewer` and an `answers` list. Each applicable answer has `case_id`, `run_id`, `trial`, `item`, integer `score` (0 or 1), and a nonempty `citation` found in that run's report. Record rationale and disagreements alongside it. Do not submit N/A rows for inapplicable cells. The scorer derives applicability; missing, duplicate, unknown, incorrectly N/A or unrelated cells fail. Challenge markers and actual exposure must be retained and independently checked. Q1–Q4 NEEDS_REVIEW and human semantic judgments remain separate.\n \n ## Package and verify from a fresh checkout\n \n After sanitization and human review, run from the repository root:\n \n ```sh\n python tests/member_c_verification/live/package_gov004.py tests/member_c_verification/live/evidence /tmp/gov004-package --scores tests/member_c_verification/live/evidence/gov004_scores.json\n GOV004_EVIDENCE_DIR=/tmp/gov004-package python tests/member_c_verification/live/score_gov004.py /tmp/gov004-package/gov004_scores.json\n ```\n \n The destination must not already exist. The exporter copies only referenced reports/manifests and the cohort, evidence and scoring files, rewrites paths (including for the versioned `gov004_starts.json` start ledger and per-attempt `gov004_attempt_*.json` files), and emits `integrity.json`. Unresolved starts and all denominators survive the export. It refuses detected credential text rather than silently changing scored evidence. Review other sensitive content manually; automatic scanning cannot certify privacy. Move the package to a second path or fresh checkout (a different working directory) and repeat scoring; only relative artifact paths may be relied on. PASS=0, FAIL=1, PENDING=2. PENDING is never acceptance. Compare integrity hashes after transfer; retain the archive in an agreed durable location.\n \n The tracked ignore rules exclude private generated live evidence. Deliberate sanitized packages may be retained outside that tree after owner review. This workflow is not recovery of missing historical evidence and does not itself grant formal approval.\n",

        "deletions": 0,
        "status": "modified"
